notes.title: Last Moments to Save BIG $$$ on ORION!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JQTNdKt.png[/img]

It is coming down to the last few days where you can save big money on ORION for the last time!  We will have to submit new pricing model changes and give enough time for the Steam platform to receive, review and implement these change.  

[h1]ONLY A FEW DAYS LEFT...[/h1]
While Guardians of Orion will celebrate its official release on December 20, 2016 the pricing model may update a bit sooner than that so grab it while you can and make sure to tell all your friends!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791440487256/announcements/detail/535196616399406194] here[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791440487256/announcements/detail/535195983114264919] here[/url], [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/407840/announcements/detail/603875242708284124] here[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791440487256/announcements/detail/586986260702604379] here[/url].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_hXlNU-Khkk

We have attempted many other models and opportunities, all of which are 3rd party or out of our control.  So we must simply use the variables we *do* have direct control over and this includes pricing models.

The new pricing model (only affecting new buyers starting Dec 20, 2016 and any gift copies you may already have in your inventory once this date is passed) is reflected below:
[i]
• ORION (Starter Edition) $24.99
• ORION (Pioneer Edition) $49.99
• ORION (Elite Edition) $99.99
[/i]

The pricing model for our first game, ORION: Prelude will also be changing*:
[i]
• ORION: Prelude (Starter Edition) $4.99*
• ORION: Prelude (Ultimate Edition) $9.99
[/i]

You have two weeks to save BIG on Orion!
#ORION is a #SciFi #MMO #RPG #Galactic #Shooter available on #Steam and features #Dinosaurs #Jetpacks & #Spaceships 
Built with #Unreal Engine 
So spread the word!  Early birds get the worms.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900
http://store.steampowered.com/app/538190/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840
http://store.steampowered.com/app/511310/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/493610/

[img]http://i.imgur.com/eT7ouSD.png[/img]
It is no surprise that we constantly want to grow and evolve our games. Guardians of Orion is no different! We have so many ideas for content and modules and so do our fans. We want to make as many of them as possible and the developers on Guardians of Orion have been willing to commit years of their life to fulfilling this experience! 
https://www.patreon.com/trekindustries 

( PATREON ) 
Our first goal with Patreon (monthly crowdfunding) is to offset the current costs of servers via community support and rewards. The largest expense every month is the server infrastructure/operational costs. 
https://www.patreon.com/trekindustries 

( EXCLUSIVE REWARDS FOR PATRONS ) 
We like to offer incredible rewards whenever it comes to fan involvement and our Patreon will offer the most exclusive and incredible rewards to date. We have options for rewards such as: 
· Access to DevBetas 
· Access to DevDiscords 
· Access to Patron-only updates & information 
· 1on1 Monthly Dev Chats (Skype/Facetime) 
· Private Group Monthly Dev Meetings 
· Priority Access to many modules, events and savings 
· A variety of music albums! 
· Invites to local meetups 
· Invites to VIP events (conferences, expos, release parties) 
· Physical Items (Shirts, Hoodies, Coffee Cups) 
· Limited Edition Items (Statues, Plushies) 
· Savings on all Trek/Orion Games 
· Coupons for the Trek Store 
& more! 

( SUSTAINABILITY ) 
The *good* thing about these servers is that the current price will not grow much even if the player count increases as this is simply the minimum viable operational costs for them to exist. The only times they would grow is when we add ADDITIONAL servers such as new locations around the world to help users better connect. 

( MORE APPROACHABLE ) 
This also keeps the crowdfunding total(s) significantly lower allowing for much more achievable community-based goals, a win for both developers and fans alike. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XEMSLPP.png[/img]

( LESS=MORE ) 
The less we have to invest in the operational costs of these servers the more we can invest into adding new content and modules that further your game experience. 

( OUR MEDICINE ) 
We've been working extremely hard on Guardians of Orion v2.0. We are on track for the public release which is rapidly approaching on Dec 20, 2016 and we expect that the new pricing model and content model will better support the game going forward to where we can focus on more exciting goals and continue to evolve the game in exciting and new ways courtesy of your interaction and support. 

( OFFICIAL RELEASE ) 
Guardians of Orion is officially releasing via Steam on December 20, 2016. Buy it now while in Early Access to save big $$$

https://www.patreon.com/trekindustries 

( EXCLUSIVE REWARDS FOR PATRONS ) 
We like to offer incredible rewards whenever it comes to fan involvement and our Patreon will offer the most exclusive and incredible rewards to date. We have options for rewards such as: 
· Access to DevBetas 
· Access to DevDiscords 
· Access to Patron-only updates & information 
· 1on1 Monthly Dev Chats (Skype/Facetime) 
· Private Group Monthly Dev Meetings 
· Priority Access to many modules, events and savings 
· A variety of music albums! 
· Invites to local meetups 
· Invites to VIP events (conferences, expos, release parties) 
· Physical Items (Shirts, Hoodies, Coffee Cups) 
· Limited Edition Items (Statues, Plushies) 
· Savings on all Trek/Orion Games 
· Coupons for the Trek Store 
& more! 

( SUSTAINABILITY ) 
The *good* thing about these servers is that the current price will not grow much even if the player count increases as this is simply the minimum viable operational costs for them to exist. The only times they would grow is when we add ADDITIONAL servers such as new locations around the world to help users better connect. 

( MORE APPROACHABLE ) 
This also keeps the crowdfunding total(s) significantly lower allowing for much more achievable community-based goals, a win for both developers and fans alike. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XEMSLPP.png[/img]

( LESS=MORE ) 
The less we have to invest in the operational costs of these servers the more we can invest into adding new content and modules that further your game experience. 

( OUR MEDICINE ) 
We've been working extremely hard on Guardians of Orion v2.0. We are on track for the public release which is rapidly approaching on Dec 20, 2016 and we expect that the new pricing model and content model will better support the game going forward to where we can focus on more exciting goals and continue to evolve the game in exciting and new ways courtesy of your interaction and support. 

( OFFICIAL RELEASE ) 
Guardians of Orion is officially releasing via Steam on December 20, 2016. Buy it now while in Early Access to save big $$$

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/407840/discussions/0/217691032444720657/] [ From the original ORION v2.0 Press Release ] [/url]
[quote]
We need to ensure that any still-standing bugs/anomalies are eradicated and that players old and new start from a similar perspective. To do this we will be launching a full reset for all Accounts to coincide with the ORION Official Release. The reset *won't* include any purchases you've made at the Trek Store. The reset *will* include the following:
[i]
• Ion Currency
• Trek Credits
• Inventory/Gear
• Guardian Levels
• Skills/Progression
[/i]

[h1]REWARDS PROGRAM[/h1]
To supplement this for our early adopters we will be creating a Rewards system that will take into account all of their achieved progress to distribute appreciation. More details on this Reward System will be revealed as we approach ORION's Official Release! We appreciate everyone's help and feedback during this period of Early Access and will ensure that their invested time is respected. The more you accomplish leading up to the release the more you will start with.
[/quote]

https://youtu.be/_hXlNU-Khkk

[h1]All accounts are affected, including our very own.[/h1]


[h1]DISCLOSURE[/h1]
This was one of the harder choices we had to make pertaining to this game and one that wasn't taken lightly.  We have more to share on what caused this and how deeply it was rooted but we cannot share this information until after v2.0 is released.  We [b]will[/b] release this information and ban those responsible or who participated at that time.


[h1]WHO WE ARE[/h1]
There are two kinds of people when presented something unexpected: one who does nothing and the other one that act on it, despite any difficulty associated. When push comes to shove, we prefer to fall into the latter group.


[h1]COMPLETING THE FOUNDATION[/h1]
We worked very hard this last year, especially once we committed to and announced the evolution from Guardians of Orion (GOO) to The Orion Project (TOP). 

We did this to ensure that the major construction/reworking and integration of all these new systems was completed as a foundation as fast as possible to get the nasty bugs out of the way. 


[h1]FROM TOP-DOWN TO GALACTIC MMO[/h1]
It wasn't an easy choice but the reality is that the game evolved from a Top-Down shooter to an Open Galaxy/Open World MMO.

The amount of work required to get there was very complex and challenging, especially in the time frame in which we had completed it.


[h1]ONWARD, TOGETHER[/h1]
All major systems are now integrated including: Multi-Perspective, Cooperative, PvP, Player Mechanics, Ship Mechanics, Progression/Gear and many others. From here on out it's simply a production of polish and growth, doing more NPC's, more story, more missions, more quests, more raids, more guardians, more regions, more ships, more weapons, etc.

Courtesy of all of this work being out of the way now we don't anticipate we'd have to do a reset going forward, on Year 3 for example.


[h1]PLAY NOW FOR 2.0 REWARDS![/h1]
We encourage all players to continue leveling and tackling objectives as the more you do now the more you will start with on Year 2.0. We also encourage all players to use any resources they have now and to convert them to any armors, hats, guardians, boosters or editions they like before we approach the Year 2 model.

• Levels reset to 1
• Skill Tree Data Wiped
• Rewards 250 TC per level 50

[b][ Inventory Data Reset ][/b]
• All items removed
• Except for XP Boosters, Ion Chunks and Ion Clusters
• Reward 10 ion per white crafting mat lost
• Reward 20 ion per green crafting mat lost
• Reward 30 ion per yellow crafting mat lost
• Reward 50 ion per purple crafting mat lost
• Reward 1 enhanced crafting mat for every green piece of equippable gear lost
• Reward 1 super enhanced crafting mat for every yellow piece of equippable gear lost
• Reward 1 legendary crafting mat for every purple piece of equippable gear lost

[b][ Stats and Achievements ][/b]
• Stats and Achievements reset to 0
• Reward 1000 TC if total kills is over 100,000
• Reward 600 TC if total kills is over 75,000
• Reward 250 TC if total kills is over 50,000
• Reward 100 TC if total kills is over 25,000
• Reward 50 TC if total kills is over 10,000
• Reward 1000 TC if total achievement points at least 78,000
• Reward 600 TC if total achievement points at least 60,000
• Reward 250 TC if total achievement points at least 40,000
• Reward 100 TC if total achievement points at least 20,000
• Reward 50 TC if total achievement points at least 5,000
• Reward 1000 TC if wave 50 Survival Completed
• Reward 600 TC if wave 40 Survival Completed
• Reward 250 TC if wave 30 Survival Completed
• Reward 100 TC if wave 20 Survival Completed
• Reward 50 TC if wave 10 Survival Completed
• These bonuses do not stack, you get your highest completed per category
• Reward 1000 ion per achievement completed

[b][ Ion Currency/TC ][/b]
• Reset to 0
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]WHAT IS SAFE?[/h1]
• ALL Store Purchases (Hats, Helmets, Armors, Cloth, Shaders, Blinks, Tracers, Pets, etc)
• ALL Elite/Standard crates
• ALL ION Chunks & Clusters
• ALL XP Boosters
• Edition - Founder (Perks are kept, TC bonus to be awarded again)
• Edition - Pioneer (Perks are kept, TC bonus to be awarded again)
• Edition - Elite (Perks are kept, TC bonus to be awarded again)
[/quote]

notes.title: Campaigns, Raids & Warriors
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eAxy4Cl.png[/img]

Atten Hut, Guardians!  We have some exciting developments and news to share pertaining to some of the best content coming your way very soon!

We are going to be making the debut of the melee-based Warrior Guardian in the upcoming massive & game-changing update that is Guardians of Orion v2.0 - launching via Steam on December 20, 2016!

https://youtu.be/S_KRs22ki7E

[h1]( PRIORITY ACCESS ) (Elite Edition & Founders)[/h1]
Elite Edition owners and Founders will have first access to the Warrior Guardian and it will be automatically unlocked for you special supporters.  Thank you very much :)

https://youtu.be/TQgz1xScVhw


[h1]( STANDARD ACCESS ) (Starter & Pioneer)[/h1]
We're doing something special/unique with the debut of this Guardian and it will be unlocked via gameplay/skill rather than currency/payment.  Specifically once you beat the Campaign/Raid#1 you will unlock this amazing new Guardian.


[h1]( EPISODE 001 ) ("Welcome to Orion")[/h1]
The cooperative campaign module is becoming something special and we want to spend a bit more time on it.  It will be the first big update in 2017 and we're very excited to see what everyone thinks.


[h1]( THE LABYRINTH ) (Raid #1)[/h1]
With the extra focus on the Campaign we are also shaping the Final Mission to be Raid #1.  This will be an incredible experience that contains combat, platforming, boss fights and more and once you beat this you will unlock the Warrior Guardian.  This is the model we intend to use for future episode where each final mission will act as a Raid that unlocks something epic!

Both Episode 1 and Raid #1 are scheduled to launch Q1 2017 as a free update to Guardians of Orion, adding hours of cooperative and lore-filled gameplay!


[h1]( THE UNLOCKS )[/h1]
Once you complete Episode 001 and Raid #1 you will unlock the Warrior Guardian, including:
· Access to the full-fledged Melee Combat system.
· Access to the Ion Force Ability.
· Access to the Warrior Armor Set.
· Access to the Warrior Helmet.


[h1]( BEHIND THE SCENES )[/h1]
We've recently started video-logging the behind-the-scenes developments and activities for parts of Trek and Orion.  Feel free to catch up on some of the previous episodes and maybe you'll even discover a few things that haven't even been announced yet!

https://youtu.be/GkS-j3m7j0M
https://youtu.be/XmEM0XWd7KU
https://youtu.be/lMGMlwuZEV0
https://youtu.be/Axard5LBLzg
https://youtu.be/2qkdW2-hiZA


[h1]( LIKE OUR MUSIC? )[/h1]
It is now available! 
Frankie - "Vibes"
https://frankiemusic.bandcamp.com/album/vibes
Frankie - "Waves"
https://frankiemusic.bandcamp.com/album/waves


[h1]( ORION GAMES @ STEAM )[/h1]
· Orion: Prelude (Starter Edition)
http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900/
· Orion: Prelude (Ultimate Upgrade)
http://store.steampowered.com/app/538190/

notes.title: ORION 2.0 "FRESH START" Full Details
notes.content:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/407840/discussions/0/217691032444720657/] [ From the original ORION v2.0 Press Release ] [/url]
[quote]
We need to ensure that any still-standing bugs/anomalies are eradicated and that players old and new start from a similar perspective. To do this we will be launching a full reset for all Accounts to coincide with the ORION Official Release. The reset *won't* include any purchases you've made at the Trek Store. The reset *will* include the following:
[i]
• Ion Currency
• Trek Credits
• Inventory/Gear
• Guardian Levels
• Skills/Progression
[/i]

[h1]REWARDS PROGRAM[/h1]
To supplement this for our early adopters we will be creating a Rewards system that will take into account all of their achieved progress to distribute appreciation. More details on this Reward System will be revealed as we approach ORION's Official Release! We appreciate everyone's help and feedback during this period of Early Access and will ensure that their invested time is respected. The more you accomplish leading up to the release the more you will start with.
[/quote]

https://youtu.be/_hXlNU-Khkk

[h1]All accounts are affected, including our very own.[/h1]


[h1]DISCLOSURE[/h1]
This was one of the harder choices we had to make pertaining to this game and one that wasn't taken lightly.  We have more to share on what caused this and how deeply it was rooted but we cannot share this information until after v2.0 is released.  We [b]will[/b] release this information and ban those responsible or who participated at that time.


[h1]WHO WE ARE[/h1]
There are two kinds of people when presented something unexpected: one who does nothing and the other one that act on it, despite any difficulty associated. When push comes to shove, we prefer to fall into the latter group.


[h1]COMPLETING THE FOUNDATION[/h1]
We worked very hard this last year, especially once we committed to and announced the evolution from Guardians of Orion (GOO) to The Orion Project (TOP). 

We did this to ensure that the major construction/reworking and integration of all these new systems was completed as a foundation as fast as possible to get the nasty bugs out of the way. 


[h1]FROM TOP-DOWN TO GALACTIC MMO[/h1]
It wasn't an easy choice but the reality is that the game evolved from a Top-Down shooter to an Open Galaxy/Open World MMO.

The amount of work required to get there was very complex and challenging, especially in the time frame in which we had completed it.


[h1]ONWARD, TOGETHER[/h1]
All major systems are now integrated including: Multi-Perspective, Cooperative, PvP, Player Mechanics, Ship Mechanics, Progression/Gear and many others. From here on out it's simply a production of polish and growth, doing more NPC's, more story, more missions, more quests, more raids, more guardians, more regions, more ships, more weapons, etc.

Courtesy of all of this work being out of the way now we don't anticipate we'd have to do a reset going forward, on Year 3 for example.


[h1]PLAY NOW FOR 2.0 REWARDS![/h1]
We encourage all players to continue leveling and tackling objectives as the more you do now the more you will start with on Year 2.0. We also encourage all players to use any resources they have now and to convert them to any armors, hats, guardians, boosters or editions they like before we approach the Year 2 model.

[quote]
[h1]WHAT IS BEING RESET?[/h1]
[b][ Character Data Reset ][/b]
• Levels reset to 1
• Skill Tree Data Wiped
• Rewards 250 TC per level 50

[b][ Inventory Data Reset ][/b]
• All items removed
• Except for XP Boosters, Ion Chunks and Ion Clusters
• Reward 10 ion per white crafting mat lost
• Reward 20 ion per green crafting mat lost
• Reward 30 ion per yellow crafting mat lost
• Reward 50 ion per purple crafting mat lost
• Reward 1 enhanced crafting mat for every green piece of equippable gear lost
• Reward 1 super enhanced crafting mat for every yellow piece of equippable gear lost
• Reward 1 legendary crafting mat for every purple piece of equippable gear lost

[b][ Stats and Achievements ][/b]
• Stats and Achievements reset to 0
• Reward 1000 TC if total kills is over 100,000
• Reward 600 TC if total kills is over 75,000
• Reward 250 TC if total kills is over 50,000
• Reward 100 TC if total kills is over 25,000
• Reward 50 TC if total kills is over 10,000
• Reward 1000 TC if total achievement points at least 78,000
• Reward 600 TC if total achievement points at least 60,000
• Reward 250 TC if total achievement points at least 40,000
• Reward 100 TC if total achievement points at least 20,000
• Reward 50 TC if total achievement points at least 5,000
• Reward 1000 TC if wave 50 Survival Completed
• Reward 600 TC if wave 40 Survival Completed
• Reward 250 TC if wave 30 Survival Completed
• Reward 100 TC if wave 20 Survival Completed
• Reward 50 TC if wave 10 Survival Completed
• These bonuses do not stack, you get your highest completed per category
• Reward 1000 ion per achievement completed

[b][ Ion Currency/TC ][/b]
• Reset to 0
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]WHAT IS SAFE?[/h1]
• ALL Store Purchases (Hats, Helmets, Armors, Cloth, Shaders, Blinks, Tracers, Pets, etc)
• ALL Elite/Standard crates
• ALL ION Chunks & Clusters
• ALL XP Boosters
• Edition - Founder (Perks are kept, TC bonus to be awarded again)
• Edition - Pioneer (Perks are kept, TC bonus to be awarded again)
• Edition - Elite (Perks are kept, TC bonus to be awarded again)
[/quote]


We will be showing active developments and streams of WIP gameplay for ORION 2.0 on our Twitch.TV @ https://www.twitch.tv/dprassel
• Stream #1 // 11:00AM Pacific Time (1pm Central)
• Stream #2 // 3:00PM Pacific Time (5pm Central)

Come hang out with David & Frankie + feel free to ask us any questions regarding development!

ORION is a #SciFi #MMO #RPG #Shooter featuring #Spaceships and #Dinosaurs.
On #Kickstarter
http://kck.st/2dPtKPO 
Built with Unreal Engine

TL;DR: Play now to start with more on the ORION 2.0 Launch.

notes.title: ORION v2.0 (Coming Dec 20, 2016)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JQTNdKt.png[/img]

[h1]TREK DEVELOPMENTS[/h1]
We've made incredible strides and have exceeded even our own expectations.  Modules such as NPC's, StarShips, WarGames DogFighting and many others weren't even scheduled for arrival until early 2017 with the loftiest projections, yet we are delivering them within Q4 2016.
https://youtu.be/_hXlNU-Khkk

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XEMSLPP.png[/img]

[h1]VERSION 2.0[/h1]
We've gathered critical information during Year One and we will be changing things up for ORION going forward.  Originally v1.7 was expected to come next, however we made great progress internally and much of what was slated for 2017 is now coming 2016. This is extremely exciting considering originally v2.0 was tied towards the success of our Kickstarter but we are able to get it out regardless for our fans to enjoy.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RVKnXZ7.png[/img]

[h1]WHAT ABOUT THE 2.0 BETA?[/h1]
If the Kickstarter proves to be successful we'd attach this reward to another massive update, such as 2.X or 3.0.  No reason to hinder progress and so we are continuing to march onward as much as possible on an internal level.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cluQIEO.png[/img]

[h1]EARLY ACCESS[/h1]
Early Access, by description, is a period for you to gather information, experiment with a variety of mechanics and systems, see what works, what doesn't and do more or less respectfully.  It is a period to evaluate pricing models, content support models and overall feedback regarding game direction.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/i4StbJX.png[/img]

[h1]FRESH START[/h1]
We need to ensure that any still-standing bugs/anomalies are eradicated and that players old and new start from a similar perspective.  To do this we will be launching a full reset for all Accounts to coincide with the ORION Official Release.  The reset *won't* include any purchases you've made at the Trek Store.  The reset *will* include the following:
• Ion Currency
• Trek Credits
• Inventory/Gear
• Guardian Levels
• Skills/Progression

[img]http://i.imgur.com/J8fV2WA.png[/img]

[h1]REWARDS PROGRAM[/h1]
To supplement this for our early adopters we will be creating a Rewards system that will take into account all of their achieved progress to distribute appreciation.  More details on this Reward System will be revealed as we approach ORION's Official Release!  We appreciate everyone's help and feedback during this period of Early Access and will ensure that their invested time is respected.  The more you accomplish leading up to the release the more you will start with.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/knFxGs8.png[/img]

[h1]REMASTERED+OPTIMIZED[/h1]
We've revised and remastered most major systems and all regions in the game.  This includes weapon mechanics, player movement mechanics and aiming mechanics!
https://youtu.be/fIkXIVUgy7Y


[h1]AIM-DOWN-SIGHTS[/h1]
This was one of the most demanded features and we've heard and listened to you.  We weren't expecting to get this in until 2017 but we worked hard to make sure it appeared for the Official Release!
https://youtu.be/jm6LBJGKWW4

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rXtRHSd.png[/img]

[h1]PRE-CAMPAIGN & RPG MISSIONS[/h1]
We will be launching with the very first Mission to see what players enjoy, what works, and what doesn't.  We're ready and would love to update this Campaign monthly to create the planned "Annual Campaign" but this fully depends on support!  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/kltfQPW.png[/img]

[h1]STARSHIP MODULE + FLIGHT MODEL[/h1]
Another module that is going to debut early is the StarShip module.  While confirmed for 2017 many hardcore fans may have likely heard David said that he wanted to do his best to get it out for the Winter Holiday.  We are proud to say that the team has achieved this and we cannot wait to take to the skies with you over Winter Break!
https://youtu.be/4cu02qXJ-NI

[img]http://i.imgur.com/NtjCNP3.png[/img]


[h1]WARGAMES MODULE[/h1]
Not only will you be able to fly and roam about with friends to pass time but you can make things get a bit more competitive and take them on in a 24-Player FFA PvP mod called WarGames.  This PvP mode, like the PlanetSide PvP mode known as Mayhem, rewards Players with ION Currency, Store Credits AND Experience/Progression!  We like to make sure both PvE and PvP experiences reward the player experience as we know many prefer one over the other!
https://youtu.be/BFUY-5Z3lek

[h1]MAYHEM+ MODULE[/h1]
We've completely reworked Mayhem including granting the universal evade ability of Power Jumps to ALL Guardians.  This is in addition to the new Player Movement, Weapon Mechanics, Aim-Down-Sights and polished+remastered regions!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6rvwaFW.png[/img]


[h1]DUEL MODULE[/h1]
Another module coming early will be the DUEL Module.  This will begin as a 1v1 high-stakes tournament and has room to grow into additional and new experiences.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FbLbyKP.png[/img]

[h1]NEW GUARDIAN - "THE WARRIOR"[/h1]
We are integrating the next Guardian (#9) to the mix and it is one of the most demanded!  This is the Melee-based Guardian and he will have Ionic Energy abilities.  We look forward to showing him off fully soon, just needing to integrate a few more mechanics and polish some others.


[h1]ION BLADE + MELEE COMBAT SYSTEM[/h1]
With the addition of this Guardian it has required us to create a full-fledged Melee Combat System including Light Attacks, Heavy Attacks, Combos, Blocks, Counters and more.  We will also be demonstrating this system and the full capabilities of it once it’s a bit more complete.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/i61D7QY.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW PRICING MODEL[/h1]
Earlier in 2016 [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/407840/announcements/detail/820031223240116735] we discussed[/url] Loss-Leader Marketing and the $1 pricing model.  This had one requirement ([i]volume, by accessibility[/i]) and this worked incredibly well for our first game, ORION: Prelude and a model we had tested for over three years.  However it has not been as successful for our current game, The ORION Project.

[i]We've learned a lot through the first year of development on The ORION Project and we will be using this gathered information as we better position ourselves to ensure that we are successful in the future.[/i]

We will be launching a new pricing model for The ORION Project coinciding with the debut of the Version 2.0 (Year 2) on December 20, 2016.  If you'd like to save dollars we highly encourage ANYONE and EVERYONE to purchase ORION currently available on Steam while it is still in using the Year One pricing model. 

The new pricing model (only affecting new buyers starting Dec 20, 2016 and any gift copies you may already have in your inventory once this date is passed) is reflected below:
[i]
•	ORION (Starter Edition) $24.99
•	ORION (Pioneer Edition) $49.99
•	ORION (Elite Edition) $99.99
[/i]

The pricing model for our first game, ORION: Prelude will also be changing*:
[i]
•	ORION: Prelude (Starter Edition) $4.99*
•	ORION: Prelude (Ultimate Edition) $9.99
[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/kltfQPW.png[/img]

[h1]SUCCESS & FAILURE[/h1]
This game shouldn't even exist considering both ([url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/the-orion-project] 001[/url], [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion] 002[/url]) failed Kickstarters. When any other Kickstarter fails the company take it as a sign of a product not being desired. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion/posts/1395367] They certainly don't honor a failed campaign like we did.[/url]


[h1]EARLY ROOTS[/h1]
[url=https://youtu.be/22c1aqrd1bg] We've changed so much within the game in a single year[/url].  What started with it's debut on December 1, 2015 as 'Guardians of Orion', a retro-inspired Top-Down Shooter and later evolving into The ORION Project, one of our oldest designs here at Trek.   For a full list of module additions and major system integrations:
[i]
•  Third Person Module
•  Top-Down Module
•  First Person Module
•  Social Hub Module
•  Inventory/Gear Module
•  Loot/Crate Module
•  Crafting Module
•  Wildlife Module (Dinosaurs/Creatures)
•  Drone Module
•  Mission Module
•  Achievement Module
•  Progression/Skills Module
•  Statistics Module
•  Leaderboard Module

notes.title: ORION v2.0 (Coming Dec 20, 2016)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JQTNdKt.png[/img]

[h1]TREK DEVELOPMENTS[/h1]
We've made incredible strides and have exceeded even our own expectations.  Modules such as NPC's, StarShips, WarGames DogFighting and many others weren't even scheduled for arrival until early 2017 with the loftiest projections, yet we are delivering them within Q4 2016.
https://youtu.be/_hXlNU-Khkk

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XEMSLPP.png[/img]

[h1]VERSION 2.0[/h1]
We've gathered critical information during Year One and we will be changing things up for ORION going forward.  Originally v1.7 was expected to come next, however we made great progress internally and much of what was slated for 2017 is now coming 2016. This is extremely exciting considering originally v2.0 was tied towards the success of our Kickstarter but we are able to get it out regardless for our fans to enjoy.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RVKnXZ7.png[/img]

[h1]WHAT ABOUT THE 2.0 BETA?[/h1]
If the Kickstarter proves to be successful we'd attach this reward to another massive update, such as 2.X or 3.0.  No reason to hinder progress and so we are continuing to march onward as much as possible on an internal level.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cluQIEO.png[/img]

[h1]EARLY ACCESS[/h1]
Early Access, by description, is a period for you to gather information, experiment with a variety of mechanics and systems, see what works, what doesn't and do more or less respectfully.  It is a period to evaluate pricing models, content support models and overall feedback regarding game direction.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/i4StbJX.png[/img]

[h1]FRESH START[/h1]
We need to ensure that any still-standing bugs/anomalies are eradicated and that players old and new start from a similar perspective.  To do this we will be launching a full reset for all Accounts to coincide with the ORION Official Release.  The reset *won't* include any purchases you've made at the Trek Store.  The reset *will* include the following:
• Ion Currency
• Trek Credits
• Inventory/Gear
• Guardian Levels
• Skills/Progression

[img]http://i.imgur.com/J8fV2WA.png[/img]

[h1]REWARDS PROGRAM[/h1]
To supplement this for our early adopters we will be creating a Rewards system that will take into account all of their achieved progress to distribute appreciation.  More details on this Reward System will be revealed as we approach ORION's Official Release!  We appreciate everyone's help and feedback during this period of Early Access and will ensure that their invested time is respected.  The more you accomplish leading up to the release the more you will start with.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/knFxGs8.png[/img]

[h1]REMASTERED+OPTIMIZED[/h1]
We've revised and remastered most major systems and all regions in the game.  This includes weapon mechanics, player movement mechanics and aiming mechanics!
https://youtu.be/fIkXIVUgy7Y


[h1]AIM-DOWN-SIGHTS[/h1]
This was one of the most demanded features and we've heard and listened to you.  We weren't expecting to get this in until 2017 but we worked hard to make sure it appeared for the Official Release!
https://youtu.be/jm6LBJGKWW4

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rXtRHSd.png[/img]

[h1]PRE-CAMPAIGN & RPG MISSIONS[/h1]
We will be launching with the very first Mission to see what players enjoy, what works, and what doesn't.  We're ready and would love to update this Campaign monthly to create the planned "Annual Campaign" but this fully depends on support!  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/kltfQPW.png[/img]

[h1]STARSHIP MODULE + FLIGHT MODEL[/h1]
Another module that is going to debut early is the StarShip module.  While confirmed for 2017 many hardcore fans may have likely heard David said that he wanted to do his best to get it out for the Winter Holiday.  We are proud to say that the team has achieved this and we cannot wait to take to the skies with you over Winter Break!
https://youtu.be/4cu02qXJ-NI

[img]http://i.imgur.com/NtjCNP3.png[/img]


[h1]WARGAMES MODULE[/h1]
Not only will you be able to fly and roam about with friends to pass time but you can make things get a bit more competitive and take them on in a 24-Player FFA PvP mod called WarGames.  This PvP mode, like the PlanetSide PvP mode known as Mayhem, rewards Players with ION Currency, Store Credits AND Experience/Progression!  We like to make sure both PvE and PvP experiences reward the player experience as we know many prefer one over the other!
https://youtu.be/BFUY-5Z3lek

[h1]MAYHEM+ MODULE[/h1]
We've completely reworked Mayhem including granting the universal evade ability of Power Jumps to ALL Guardians.  This is in addition to the new Player Movement, Weapon Mechanics, Aim-Down-Sights and polished+remastered regions!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6rvwaFW.png[/img]


[h1]DUEL MODULE[/h1]
Another module coming early will be the DUEL Module.  This will begin as a 1v1 high-stakes tournament and has room to grow into additional and new experiences.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FbLbyKP.png[/img]

[h1]NEW GUARDIAN - "THE WARRIOR"[/h1]
We are integrating the next Guardian (#9) to the mix and it is one of the most demanded!  This is the Melee-based Guardian and he will have Ionic Energy abilities.  We look forward to showing him off fully soon, just needing to integrate a few more mechanics and polish some others.


[h1]ION BLADE + MELEE COMBAT SYSTEM[/h1]
With the addition of this Guardian it has required us to create a full-fledged Melee Combat System including Light Attacks, Heavy Attacks, Combos, Blocks, Counters and more.  We will also be demonstrating this system and the full capabilities of it once it’s a bit more complete.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/i61D7QY.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW PRICING MODEL[/h1]
Earlier in 2016 [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/407840/announcements/detail/820031223240116735] we discussed[/url] Loss-Leader Marketing and the $1 pricing model.  This had one requirement ([i]volume, by accessibility[/i]) and this worked incredibly well for our first game, ORION: Prelude and a model we had tested for over three years.  However it has not been as successful for our current game, The ORION Project.

[i]We've learned a lot through the first year of development on The ORION Project and we will be using this gathered information as we better position ourselves to ensure that we are successful in the future.[/i]

We will be launching a new pricing model for The ORION Project coinciding with the debut of the Version 2.0 (Year 2) on December 20, 2016.  If you'd like to save dollars we highly encourage ANYONE and EVERYONE to purchase ORION currently available on Steam while it is still in using the Year One pricing model. 

The new pricing model (only affecting new buyers starting Dec 20, 2016 and any gift copies you may already have in your inventory once this date is passed) is reflected below:
[i]
•	ORION (Starter Edition) $24.99
•	ORION (Pioneer Edition) $49.99
•	ORION (Elite Edition) $99.99
[/i]

The pricing model for our first game, ORION: Prelude will also be changing*:
[i]
•	ORION: Prelude (Starter Edition) $4.99*
•	ORION: Prelude (Ultimate Edition) $9.99
[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/kltfQPW.png[/img]

[h1]SUCCESS & FAILURE[/h1]
This game shouldn't even exist considering both ([url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/the-orion-project] 001[/url], [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion] 002[/url]) failed Kickstarters. When any other Kickstarter fails the company take it as a sign of a product not being desired. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion/posts/1395367] They certainly don't honor a failed campaign like we did.[/url]


[h1]EARLY ROOTS[/h1]
[url=https://youtu.be/22c1aqrd1bg] We've changed so much within the game in a single year[/url].  What started with it's debut on December 1, 2015 as 'Guardians of Orion', a retro-inspired Top-Down Shooter and later evolving into The ORION Project, one of our oldest designs here at Trek.   For a full list of module additions and major system integrations:

•  First Person Module
•  Social Hub Module
•  Inventory/Gear Module
•  Loot/Crate Module

notes.title: Galactic Council Module (ION Blade *CONFIRMED*)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/rmWnKtC.jpg[/img]

#ORION is a #SciFi #MMO #RPG #Shooter 
Featuring #Dinosaurs #Jetpacks & #Spaceships
Now on #KickStarter 
http://kck.st/2dPtKPO

The Galactic Council (/Order of Ion) Module is a future module coming to The Orion Project that begins to involve the community in new and incredible ways. We're very big on developing this game right aside you and want to illustrate this starting here.
https://youtu.be/3KarjYE3toE

This will be an annual event and the first election will be in 2017. It will be an voting-based election and allow for 10 community members to become elected and have a seat at the Galactic Council. This will coincide with the other 10 seats primarily made up of Developers known as the "Order of Ion" and will be the acting arm for the word of the Galactic Council.


[h1]( HOW TO REGISTER )[/h1]
To become eligible for a Galactic Council seat you must prepare a presentation (written or recorded) and submit it to council@trek-industries.com by January 1, 2017. In this presentation you must cover seven topics:
[list]
[*] 1. Why are you interested? 
[*] 2. What would make you/your perspective unique? 
[*] 3. What is(are) your current favorite game(s)? 
[*] 4. What is(are) your favorite game(s) of all time? 
[*] 5. What is your Age? 
[*] 6. What is your Gender? 
[*] 7. Do you have any past experience in serving/representation in real life or another game community (admin, moderator, etc).
[/list]

[h1]( GALACTIC COUNCIL PERKS )[/h1]
As a Galactic Council member you will receive a plethora of exclusive perks, including: 
[list]
[*] Annual Seat @ Galactic Council 
[*] Access to Council Cloak 
[*] Access to Council Ion Blade 
[*] Access to Council Armor Set 
[*] Access to Council Pet 
[*] Access to Council game icon 
[*] Access to ION Council Multi-Person Starship 
[*] Access to monthly ION Meetings 
[*] Access to WIP Developer Builds 
[*] Access to exclusive Galactic areas including Shrines and Temples 
[*] Galactic protection by the Ion Drone Army
[/list]

[h1]( GALACTIC COUNCIL RESPONSIBILITIES )[/h1]
[list]
Council Members will be involved in major decisions, including but not limited to:
[*] Toxic Player Behavior & Remediation 
[*] Banning/Jailing/Fining 
[*] Aiding in Player Disputes 
[*] Access to Exclusive Missions from James Trek 
[*] Lore/Archive Buildup (finding Data Logs as a Council Member makes them available for other players to read/discover in Library/Archive areas of future modules). 
[*] + more!
[/list]
This is just a very early announcement. If anyone is interested in this module please apply and look forward to meeting you soon!

notes.title: ORION // Community Update (Q4 2016)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/2xZ5XEl.png[/img]

[h1]ORION - COMMUNITY UPDATE (OCT 2016)[/h1]
We have recently conducted a variety of pools and information gathering to learn where the Community is in regards to what they are enjoying, disliking and think of ORION.  We do these polls regularly and we appreciate all who interact with and supply feedback.  Thank you very much to all of you!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/c5ccWEZ.png[/img]

[b]You can view each of these below:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1.[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/407840/discussions/0/343787920121709087/] Best Things About The Game?[/url]
[*] 2. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/407840/discussions/0/343787920121707338/] Worst Things About The Game?[/url]
[*] 3. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791433474819/announcements/detail/845941345800176106] Thoughts About ORION PT. 1[/url]
[*] 4. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791433474819/announcements/detail/845941345800176106] Thoughts About ORION PT. 2[/url]
[/list]

[h1]BEST THINGS ABOUT ORION (MOST VOTED):[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1. Gameplay 
[*] 2. Play Styles (Gear/Skills/Abilities)
[*] 3. Player Customization
[*] 4. The Community
[*] 5. Guardian Variety
[/list]

[h1]WORST THINGS ABOUT ORION (MOST VOTED):[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1. Weapon Impact/Feel/Recoil/Movement
[*] 2. Verticality
[*] 3. Optimization (ATI/AMD)
[*] 4. Weapon Loadouts
[*] 5. Game Launch Time
[*] 7. Input Customization
[/list]

[h1]OTHER VOTES INCLUDED (SINGLE VOTES):[/h1]
[list]
[*] 1. Steam Achievements
[*] 2. Ion Conversion Ratio
[*] 3. Chat System
[*] 4. Pet Following/Proximity/Blocking
[*] 5. Third Person Camera Tweaks
[*] 6. Legendary Aug Functionality (?)
[*] 7. Gibs/Gore Improvements
[*] 8. Survival Mode Remake
[*] 9. PhysX quality options (GPU support)
[*] 10. Latency/Server improvements
[*] 11. Remade Support Ability
[/list]

[b]We've also received many fan submissions stating that they believe:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1. The game is TOO ambitious.
[*] 2. We don't address issues fast enough.
[*] 3. We add content TOO often.
[/list]

[h1]SO WHAT DO WE DO WITH THIS INFORMATION?[/h1]
Well, we use it!  We read through every post and curate lists based on the most-submitted.  If something can coexist with other systems, designs and mechanics either integrated or planned then it is included.  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dP9NeBw.png[/img]

[h1]VERSION 1.7 - NOVEMBER 2016[/h1]
Most of the main dislikes *will* be addressed in the next major update for ORION, Version 1.7  

ORION v1.7 is scheduled for release in November 2016 and we will be addressing the following:
[list]
[*] 1. Adding additional weapon loadouts per Guardian.
[*] 2. Adding ADS (Aim-Down-Sights) functionality for the FPS perspective.
[*] 3. We are revamping the Weapon Movement & Recoil systems.
[*] 4. We've improved verticality to older maps and made it a focus on the newer maps.
[*] 5. We've added small additions to A.I to better compensate for the new verticality.
[*] 6. We've added game optimizations (auto-spec detection, based on your specific hardware).
[*] 7. We've added input customization for mechanics including: Blink, Evade, Jump, Crouch.
[/list]

[h1]VERSION 1.8 & OTHER[/h1]
In addition to polishing and improving those features, we are also going to continue to focus on what the game currently has.  Version 1.8 will debut some new content but also focus on further polishing the PvE and PvP modules already within the game.  This includes Harvest, Mayhem, Survival and WarGames.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1Bd2qjL.png[/img]

[h1]POST BELOW![/h1]
We always monitor fan feedback.  Feel free to post comments, suggestions and questions below.  We always love hearing what you think!

notes.title: ORION // Full Transparency Report
notes.content:
Hey all - David here.  I am the Founder and Director of Trek Industries and the Game Director on The ORION Project.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IMMVRxJ.png[/img]

I've spent a life time seeking and recruiting the best talent from around the world.  Sometimes I was successful, others not.  Right now we have one of the best development teams ever assembled and many of them have been by my side since the beginning. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/957/432/00ceedae182ef6f27dfa0b6fa52fad47_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475460425&auto=format&lossless=true&s=928b9d30ba83a1c08a2f8aadf90bb2ed[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/957/427/3d0e0a69fab441f1262658d3fd508f91_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475460402&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5b5b527fe7d510dbb219fbbbd091c735[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/963/103/eaf4ae06bb73b53a93febea4ebe5acc1_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475506031&auto=format&lossless=true&s=3279361a585f34ba90e770c31ca179e8[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/957/426/8b865094f2bcf77a69c23250bc3d291e_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475460395&auto=format&lossless=true&s=1ac1d73a1e7e75c566f0c144f23f376e[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/963/260/f34e756f7932828c552a31c5d0f7ddb2_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475507036&auto=format&lossless=true&s=4ad6ffdd5ca02584a75de0d77d79055c[/img]

They definitely don't do it for fame or payment as they could be much more successful elsewhere and I have to believe it's because of ORION as it too had captivated me immediately from a very young age.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VFopklaUqvg

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/953/980/a7ba91f37a7fada4e207102c5dfc39b4_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475435661&auto=format&lossless=true&s=45d85f76c565d699fbcb00b141199a65[/img]


[h1]THE ORION PROJECT[/h1]
It's been my life long work to deliver this experience we've only begun to hint at in this first year.  We have a team loving what they are working on and committed years of their lives to bringing it to life.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oKk4x7OwvJQ


[h1]OUR FIRST GAME[/h1]
I've invested everything we made into remastering and repairing our first game (ORION: Prelude) to ensure we were proud of it, as we're the fans.  We are proud of what we accomplished and it's become an extremely fun Co-Op game that we and hundreds of others still enjoy to this day.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ShQ3GBFI4KQ


[h1]2014 CROWDFUNDING[/h1]
In 2014 we attempted to raise funds for The Orion Project but this was unfortunately not successful.  Instead we continued supporting ORION: Prelude and developing prototypes in the background.  
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/the-orion-project


[h1]2015 CROWDFUNDING[/h1]
In 2015 we attempted to raise funds for "Guardians of Orion", a throwback to over-the-top games and the days of SNES/Genesis.  We showcased a full playable prototype but this campaign was also unsuccessful.  
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion

However instead of ending it there we decided to honor every single backer that supported us and rewarded them a copy of various game(s) depending on pledge level.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rR0UQRV0NvY


[h1]OUR FOCUS[/h1]
We've invested all profits from the first game (ORION: Prelude/Dino Beatdown) in order to REMAKE/REMASTER and continually add content to it for years.  Most of the resources were exhausted during this development but enough were set aside to self-finance and create the prototype for Guardians of Orion/The ORION Project.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/952/836/f11193371330f0fa1036d788b0941be9_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475428308&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5e9588f40da1af13ed559936569f222d[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/952/875/fcac8bdca33586463fe0bcf7776bb4f7_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475428458&auto=format&lossless=true&s=361e7fa2c3ee71be37c90e6609b2668a[/img]


[h1]THE CHARTS[/h1]
Since July 2016 both ORION games have dramatically dropped in overall players, visibility and discoverability.  This is difficult to comprehend or link as our first game, ORION: Prelude, was just recently moved to Free-2-Play having a no-risk entry that should typically surge or at minimal maintain original/existing player count values.  

​[img]http://i.imgur.com/sPcVcyx.png[/img]
​
This was not the case and we haven't seen these low of player counts since 2013.  In addition to this our new game, The ORION Project, has dramatically dropped in player counts:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6FuiULL.png[/img]
​
The chart above illustrates to us that we were better off ceasing development in Q1 2016.  At this time the game had Third-Person, Inventory and Gear added.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/952/847/e01313a2467ed4117a5b2268e5ace52d_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475428335&auto=format&lossless=true&s=aed1c9d1b518eb0a4b9d58edfb1cad08[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/952/897/917ea4fd493231d767e33175dc911676_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475428558&auto=format&lossless=true&s=84932e744136b1e4541a9817b7ce69d1[/img]

However once we started to invest and add more, the numbers went down significantly somehow.  This is reflective of v1.5 (May 2016) and v1.6 (July 2016) which we started adding fan-favorite features like First-Person, PvP, Multi-Camera PvE and most recently SpaceShips/NPC's.  Each new iteration subsequently offers fewer and fewer players.


[h1]THE F2P CONVERSION[/h1]
Over two million accounts were supposed to receive special Premium DLC for owning ORION: Prelude pre-conversion.  Platform Linking failed and instead we were forced to grant ALL owners, including non-valid, and this cost us time, resources and it completely undervalued and depreciated all valid owners in the process.  This negatively affected us and our player base.

[b]We had two overall goals with the F2P conversion:[/b]
[list]
[*] 001 - Reward & Thank our Supporters
[*] 002 - Use 104900 (ORION: Prelude) as a marketing device towards 407840 (The ORION Project) by allowing players to play and experience the Orion game series for free.
[/list]

[b]Both objectives are complete failures and it's time to cut losses with what we do have control over.[/b]


[h1]THE MATH[/h1]
So to break this all down into the nitty gritty detail.  Since August 2010 (which is when we started pre-production on what became ORION: Prelude/Dino Beatdown) we've generated the following amount of revenue: $3,207,912

[b]For a majority of this, it was split:[/b]
[list]
[*] 30% Steam (Platform) $962,373.60
[*] 10% Epic (Engine) $320,791.20
[/list]

[i]We'll say we get 50% of the revenue stream once all things are said and done - and that's still being generous.  This is for the sake of easy math:[/i]
[list]
[*] Total Revenue Generated: [b]$3,207,912[/b]
[*] 50% (Our Operation Budget): [b]$1,603,956[/b]
[/list]
Now split this across the six years of operating and it comes down to
(Yearly) [b]$267,326[/b]
OR
(Monthly) [b]$22,277[/b]


[h1]THE BREAKDOWN[/h1]
This is purely operational and comparably it's equivalent two the salary of roughly two developers at an AAA game development studio.  So nothing exceptional by any means and it doesn't permit much (any) room for Research, Experimental and doesn't factor any plugins/api/external content or much additional hiring.  Most importantly it doesn't permit for any mistakes and requires efficiency and consistency just short of perfection.  


[h1]THE REALITY[/h1]
The reality is those are previous numbers and charts and that the current numbers right now have a level of support is only barely covering the server infrastructure and that it's never been lower than since ORION: Dino Beatdown.  


[h1]YOUR SUPPORT[/h1]
This is not sustainable in any shape way or form and if you enjoy the game now or the idea of what it can become, now is the time to show that support whether its financial or vocal.  I am more than happy to support it and invest in it MORE than we did on our first game, but we definitely need that support matched.


[h1]PRELUDE REVERSION[/h1]
If you've acquired the game for FREE during the 60 day campaign you're more than welcomed to keep the game, please help spread the word if you like it.

Please make sure to not uninstall or remove it if you've acquired it for free as the Platform is unable to determine ownership and we have no system available that would permit us the ability to verify what type of owner you are.  If you uninstall or remove the game you will be forced to acquire it via the minimal premium.

[b]Starting Monday October 24, 2016 (10:00AM PT)[/b], ORION: Prelude will be reverting to a $1 premium base model for ORION: Prelude (AppID 104900).  This will permit that the company is in a healthy position and able to ensure that the Product can be supported, hosted and patched.


[h1]INTERCEPTOR A1 & WARGAMES MODULE PRICING[/h1]
Until we can receive additional support we will have to begin changing variables that we do have immediate control over in order to ensure we can continue making the game better as well as support it for years to come.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/953/948/f668fb0c708cc3a1d1b06a39c01cb32a_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475435432&auto=format&lossless=true&s=401497d395e0e4e1726fcdbb0ec50ec4[/img]

Due to this we will not yet be able to offer a free ship to all players like we had originally intended.  We would love for nothing more than to be able to do things like this, as we regularly have in the past.  

We'd love nothing more than to offer experiences at competitive prices (or free) and amazing content, but we need to do it in a way that ensures that it's done safely for all involved.  However until other aspects change this will now be a premium acquisition.


[h1]THE PC PLATFORM[/h1]
After two years and two failed crowdfunding campaigns we are placing the future of The Orion Project in your hands.  We love the PC platform.  The core of us were born and bred in PC gaming, most of us starting with modding and eventually working our way to full time developers.  

[b]We love PC gaming, we love the PC industry and we want nothing more than to support and leave our mark within the PC industry.[/b]


[h1]WHAT WE ARE ASKING[/h1]
We love what we do, we love who we get to do it with and we love who we do it for.  I am asking for the opportunity to create, communicate, and deliver the game of my dreams and one that I believe will captivate you for years to come.  

So I implore you to do one single thing:
[b]Stop giving your money to assholes that can't deliver and give it to this one that can.[/b]


[h1]CROWDFUNDING 2016[/h1]
We've setup a crowdfunding event that puts you and the game first and foremost.  This is your chance to obtain incredible and extremely limited physical rewards as well as guarantee the required funding for certain features, modules and milestones.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/963/707/5efa35f096e7cf8272859d3544b6bb73_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475509307&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a6156af1b312d74d00d96f221a42d3c5[/img]

[b]The ORION Kickstarter crowdfunding event is scheduled to begin October 31, 2016 and end December 31, 2016.[/b]


[h1]OUR MESSAGE TO YOU[/h1]
We can make the game of our dreams, we will include you and we will support you and our products to the best of our ability for as long as we possibly can.  We've illustrated this for years and would love to do this for years to come.
[list]
[*] Do you want a developer that is transparent? 
[*] Do you want a developer that listens to you?
[*] Do you want a developer that works hard?
[*] Do you want a developer that supports their products?
[*] Do you want a product that supports their communities?
[/list]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/953/762/8eed982ef304a38b8f4df73623cfee51_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475434304&auto=format&lossless=true&s=f1a35b6f9f2d04c80e93582f5d92f1eb[/mg]

If this event is not successful I cannot guarantee the future of The Orion Project past version 1.8 until further notice.  In the end this is up to you!

[h1]I believe that if you do your job and support those who support you, then the people will decide whether or not they want to hire you for another round.  We are here in the ring and ready to fight with and for you.[/h1]

Trek.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/963/103/eaf4ae06bb73b53a93febea4ebe5acc1_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475506031&auto=format&lossless=true&s=3279361a585f34ba90e770c31ca179e8[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/957/426/8b865094f2bcf77a69c23250bc3d291e_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475460395&auto=format&lossless=true&s=1ac1d73a1e7e75c566f0c144f23f376e[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/963/260/f34e756f7932828c552a31c5d0f7ddb2_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475507036&auto=format&lossless=true&s=4ad6ffdd5ca02584a75de0d77d79055c[/img]

They definitely don't do it for fame or payment as they could be much more successful elsewhere and I have to believe it's because of ORION as it too had captivated me immediately from a very young age.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VFopklaUqvg

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/953/980/a7ba91f37a7fada4e207102c5dfc39b4_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475435661&auto=format&lossless=true&s=45d85f76c565d699fbcb00b141199a65[/img]


[h1]THE ORION PROJECT[/h1]
It's been my life long work to deliver this experience we've only begun to hint at in this first year.  We have a team loving what they are working on and committed years of their lives to bringing it to life.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oKk4x7OwvJQ


[h1]OUR FIRST GAME[/h1]
I've invested everything we made into remastering and repairing our first game (ORION: Prelude) to ensure we were proud of it, as we're the fans.  We are proud of what we accomplished and it's become an extremely fun Co-Op game that we and hundreds of others still enjoy to this day.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ShQ3GBFI4KQ


[h1]2014 CROWDFUNDING[/h1]
In 2014 we attempted to raise funds for The Orion Project but this was unfortunately not successful.  Instead we continued supporting ORION: Prelude and developing prototypes in the background.  
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/the-orion-project


[h1]2015 CROWDFUNDING[/h1]
In 2015 we attempted to raise funds for "Guardians of Orion", a throwback to over-the-top games and the days of SNES/Genesis.  We showcased a full playable prototype but this campaign was also unsuccessful.  
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/orionprelude/guardians-of-orion

However instead of ending it there we decided to honor every single backer that supported us and rewarded them a copy of various game(s) depending on pledge level.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rR0UQRV0NvY


[h1]OUR FOCUS[/h1]
We've invested all profits from the first game (ORION: Prelude/Dino Beatdown) in order to REMAKE/REMASTER and continually add content to it for years.  Most of the resources were exhausted during this development but enough were set aside to self-finance and create the prototype for Guardians of Orion/The ORION Project.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/952/836/f11193371330f0fa1036d788b0941be9_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475428308&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5e9588f40da1af13ed559936569f222d[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/952/875/fcac8bdca33586463fe0bcf7776bb4f7_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475428458&auto=format&lossless=true&s=361e7fa2c3ee71be37c90e6609b2668a[/img]


[h1]THE CHARTS[/h1]
Since July 2016 both ORION games have dramatically dropped in overall players, visibility and discoverability.  This is difficult to comprehend or link as our first game, ORION: Prelude, was just recently moved to Free-2-Play having a no-risk entry that should typically surge or at minimal maintain original/existing player count values.  

​[img]http://i.imgur.com/sPcVcyx.png[/img]
​
This was not the case and we haven't seen these low of player counts since 2013.  In addition to this our new game, The ORION Project, has dramatically dropped in player counts:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6FuiULL.png[/img]
​
The chart above illustrates to us that we were better off ceasing development in Q1 2016.  At this time the game had Third-Person, Inventory and Gear added.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/952/847/e01313a2467ed4117a5b2268e5ace52d_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475428335&auto=format&lossless=true&s=aed1c9d1b518eb0a4b9d58edfb1cad08[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/952/897/917ea4fd493231d767e33175dc911676_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475428558&auto=format&lossless=true&s=84932e744136b1e4541a9817b7ce69d1[/img]

However once we started to invest and add more, the numbers went down significantly somehow.  This is reflective of v1.5 (May 2016) and v1.6 (July 2016) which we started adding fan-favorite features like First-Person, PvP, Multi-Camera PvE and most recently SpaceShips/NPC's.  Each new iteration subsequently offers fewer and fewer players.


[h1]THE F2P CONVERSION[/h1]
Over two million accounts were supposed to receive special Premium DLC for owning ORION: Prelude pre-conversion.  Platform Linking failed and instead we were forced to grant ALL owners, including non-valid, and this cost us time, resources and it completely undervalued and depreciated all valid owners in the process.  This negatively affected us and our player base.

[b]We had two overall goals with the F2P conversion:[/b]
[list]
[*] 001 - Reward & Thank our Supporters
[*] 002 - Use 104900 (ORION: Prelude) as a marketing device towards 407840 (The ORION Project) by allowing players to play and experience the Orion game series for free.
[/list]

[b]Both objectives are complete failures and it's time to cut losses with what we do have control over.[/b]


[h1]THE MATH[/h1]
So to break this all down into the nitty gritty detail.  Since August 2010 (which is when we started pre-production on what became ORION: Prelude/Dino Beatdown) we've generated the following amount of revenue: $3,207,912

[b]For a majority of this, it was split:[/b]
[list]
[*] 30% Steam (Platform) $962,373.60
[*] 10% Epic (Engine) $320,791.20
[/list]

[i]We'll say we get 50% of the revenue stream once all things are said and done - and that's still being generous.  This is for the sake of easy math:[/i]
[list]
[*] Total Revenue Generated: [b]$3,207,912[/b]
[*] 50% (Our Operation Budget): [b]$1,603,956[/b]
[/list]
Now split this across the six years of operating and it comes down to
(Yearly) [b]$267,326[/b]
OR
(Monthly) [b]$22,277[/b]


[h1]THE BREAKDOWN[/h1]
This is purely operational and comparably it's equivalent two the salary of roughly two developers at an AAA game development studio.  So nothing exceptional by any means and it doesn't permit much (any) room for Research, Experimental and doesn't factor any plugins/api/external content or much additional hiring.  Most importantly it doesn't permit for any mistakes and requires efficiency and consistency just short of perfection.  


[h1]THE REALITY[/h1]
The reality is those are previous numbers and charts and that the current numbers right now have a level of support is only barely covering the server infrastructure and that it's never been lower than since ORION: Dino Beatdown.  


[h1]YOUR SUPPORT[/h1]
This is not sustainable in any shape way or form and if you enjoy the game now or the idea of what it can become, now is the time to show that support whether its financial or vocal.  I am more than happy to support it and invest in it MORE than we did on our first game, but we definitely need that support matched.


[h1]PRELUDE REVERSION[/h1]
If you've acquired the game for FREE during the 60 day campaign you're more than welcomed to keep the game, please help spread the word if you like it.

Please make sure to not uninstall or remove it if you've acquired it for free as the Platform is unable to determine ownership and we have no system available that would permit us the ability to verify what type of owner you are.  If you uninstall or remove the game you will be forced to acquire it via the minimal premium.

[b]Starting Monday October 24, 2016 (10:00AM PT)[/b], ORION: Prelude will be reverting to a $1 premium base model for ORION: Prelude (AppID 104900).  This will permit that the company is in a healthy position and able to ensure that the Product can be supported, hosted and patched.


[h1]INTERCEPTOR A1 & WARGAMES MODULE PRICING[/h1]
Until we can receive additional support we will have to begin changing variables that we do have immediate control over in order to ensure we can continue making the game better as well as support it for years to come.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/953/948/f668fb0c708cc3a1d1b06a39c01cb32a_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475435432&auto=format&lossless=true&s=401497d395e0e4e1726fcdbb0ec50ec4[/img]

Due to this we will not yet be able to offer a free ship to all players like we had originally intended.  We would love for nothing more than to be able to do things like this, as we regularly have in the past.  

We'd love nothing more than to offer experiences at competitive prices (or free) and amazing content, but we need to do it in a way that ensures that it's done safely for all involved.  However until other aspects change this will now be a premium acquisition.


[h1]THE PC PLATFORM[/h1]
After two years and two failed crowdfunding campaigns we are placing the future of The Orion Project in your hands.  We love the PC platform.  The core of us were born and bred in PC gaming, most of us starting with modding and eventually working our way to full time developers.  

[b]We love PC gaming, we love the PC industry and we want nothing more than to support and leave our mark within the PC industry.[/b]


[h1]WHAT WE ARE ASKING[/h1]
We love what we do, we love who we get to do it with and we love who we do it for.  I am asking for the opportunity to create, communicate, and deliver the game of my dreams and one that I believe will captivate you for years to come.  

So I implore you to do one single thing:
[b]Stop giving your money to assholes that can't deliver and give it to this one that can.[/b]


[h1]CROWDFUNDING 2016[/h1]
We've setup a crowdfunding event that puts you and the game first and foremost.  This is your chance to obtain incredible and extremely limited physical rewards as well as guarantee the required funding for certain features, modules and milestones.  

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/963/707/5efa35f096e7cf8272859d3544b6bb73_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475509307&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a6156af1b312d74d00d96f221a42d3c5[/img]

[b]The ORION Kickstarter crowdfunding event is scheduled to begin October 31, 2016 and end December 31, 2016.[/b]


[h1]OUR MESSAGE TO YOU[/h1]
We can make the game of our dreams, we will include you and we will support you and our products to the best of our ability for as long as we possibly can.  We've illustrated this for years and would love to do this for years to come.
[list]
[*] Do you want a developer that is transparent? 
[*] Do you want a developer that listens to you?
[*] Do you want a developer that works hard?
[*] Do you want a developer that supports their products?
[*] Do you want a product that supports their communities?
[/list]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/953/762/8eed982ef304a38b8f4df73623cfee51_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1475434304&auto=format&lossless=true&s=f1a35b6f9f2d04c80e93582f5d92f1eb[/mg]

If this event is not successful I cannot guarantee the future of The Orion Project past version 1.8 until further notice.  In the end this is up to you!

[h1]I believe that if you do your job and support those who support you, then the people will decide whether or not they want to hire you for another round.  We are here in the ring and ready to fight with and for you.[/h1]

Trek.

notes.title: Version 1.6.8 - Now Available (Grab YOUR 10mil ION!)
notes.content:
ORION v1.6.8 is now available!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

[h1]( Were YOU Missing ION?? )[/h1]
We have updated ALL editions of Orion based on feedback and developments as we proceed forward. 

Starting today (v1.6.8) there will be no more ION bonuses per edition of the game as there were issues in relaying that information to user accounts, creating an influx of support tickets which are distracting from the overall games development. 

More importantly it is creating an imbalance within the game and community and it is promoting Pay-2-Win, something we are against. This will allow us to maintain the rate of development which we've been going at since December 2015. 

[h1]( The Solution - LOGIN NOW! )[/h1]
To aid any gamers who purchased Pioneer OR Elite and DIDN'T receive their appropriate ION yet we will be doing a blanket insertion of 10 Million ION to ALL Users. Simply login and play between September 27 and November 1, 2016. 


[h1] ( Version 1.6.8 Changelog )[/h1]
[list]
[*] ADDED: Grab Item ability by holding USE ('E' on KBM, 'X' on Gamepad).
[*] ADJUSTED: Roll Speed to Super Jump on Skill Tree for appropriate Guardians.
[*] ADJUSTED: Increased Rocket Launcher & Grenade Launcher ammo counts.
[*] ADJUSTED: Grenade Launcher grenades now explode on impact of any surface.
[*] FIXED: Issues with unequipping gear causing visual anomalies.
[*] FIXED: Insane Harvest Daily being completed on the wrong difficulty level.
[*] FIXED: Issues with armors defaulting to being off.
[*] FIXED: Issues with hat appearing in 1P view on Recon Guardians.
[*] FIXED: Issues with the Store thinking Players owned every Guardian (sorry!).
[*] FIXED: Issues with Skin Materials reseting on opening the Appearance window.
[*] FIXED: Issues where Silver & Gold Crates would award a BLANK item.
[*] FIXED: Issues with Goto Page for Leaderboards not working.
[*] FIXED: Issues where Classes would display with armors the user didn't have in Appearance.
[*] REMOVED: ION Chunks & Clusters from Standard Crates.
[*] REMOVED: Boss Hunt objective from Mayhem PvP (temporary).
[*] REMOVED: Ion Bonus from Edition Packages and granted every player 10 Million ION.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7 Development Has Begun!
notes.content:
ORION Version 1.7 is underway.  
https://youtu.be/vO0gR5RxTEM

Let's quickly take a look back and recap all of Version 1.6 from August 18 - September 21, 2016:
-

( v1.6.8 ) September 26, 2016
ADJUSTED: Added increased checks for AFK kicks.
ADJUSTED: Reduced reward amount of ION Chunks/Clusters from Crates.
ADJUSTED: Removed ION Chunks/Clusters from Standard Crates.
ADJUSTED: Grenade Launcher projectiles now explode on impact.
ADJUSTED: GLauncher/RLauncher now has 5 shots (PvP), 10 shots (PvE).
FIXED: Issues with Default Helmets per Guardian.
REMOVED: Boss Hunt quest from Mayhem FFA (temporarily).

( v1.6.7 ) September 21, 2016
FIXED: Issues with Silver/Gold Crates not rewarding enough amazing items. 
FIXED: Crash issues when clicking 'Account Upgrades' in the Trek Store. 
FIXED: Crash issues if your Inventory was full and you picked up an item. 
FIXED: Crash issue when trying to open a Gem/Material pouch. 
FIXED: Issues with some Appearance slots not properly saving. 
FIXED: Issue with Gamepads not working properly with the Inventory. 
FIXED: Issues with Appearance items being listed multiple times. 
FIXED: Issues with Weapon Shader entries showing in Top & Bottom lists. 
FIXED: Issues with duplicating items in certain conditions. 
FIXED: Hitting 'Refresh' multiple times in the Browser causing duplication.

( v1.6.6 ) September 20, 2016
IMPROVED: Inventory back-end network code/loading. 
IMPROVED: ION item buying code. 
FIXED: Issue with Inventory rendering in ION Store. 
FIXED: Issue with a stuck Dinosaurs giving out free XP. 
ADJUSTED: Slightly buffed Automatic Shotgun damage. 
ADJUSTED: Slightly buffed Grenade Launcher explosion radius. 
ADJUSTED: Slightly buffed Grenade Launcher PvP damages. 

( v1.6.5 ) September 16, 2016
FIXED: Issue with connecting players to PvP instead of Social.

( v1.6.4 ) September 15, 2016
FIXED: Issue with users having their inventory items invisible.
FIXED: Server browser displaying wrong information.

( v1.6.3 ) September 14, 2016
FIXED: Mayhem servers being un-joinable after a map change. 
FIXED: Map change text not rendering. 
FIXED: Weekly Challenges not starting properly. 
FIXED: GLauncher Aug (for real this time). 
ADJUSTED: Boss HP for Mayhem Quests.

( v1.6.2 ) September 14, 2016
NEW: Re-did server infrastructure, including Matchmaking & Joining. 
ADDED: Trek Store Items (5 Cloth Pieces). 
ADDED: AFK kicking mechanic. 
ADDED: Custom Shader effects to 1P leg models. 
ADJUSTED: Combat Shotgun spread and damages. 
ADJUSTED: Mayhem to have 3 Objectives instead of 5 for pacing. 
FIXED: issue with Weekly Quests displaying the wrong information. 
FIXED: Sci-Fi Samurai Helmet not aligning properly. 
FIXED: inventory sorting issues. 
FIXED: issues with Pioneer Status DLC (ION). 
FIXED: issue with Grenade Launcher damage augment not working. 
FIXED: issue with Sniper and Pistol Damage helmets not working. 
FIXED: issue with Premium Prelude DLC (six helmets via Appearance).

( v1.6.1 ) September 5, 2016
ADDED: New PvP Map, Azrael 
ADDED: New PvP Map, Osiris 
ADDED: Crouch-based movement 
ADDED: Additional BoostedFrames options (90 recommended) 
ADDED: Free ELITE EDITION item: Sci-Fi Samurai Helmet 
ADDED: Free items for ALL: Six Prelude/Dino Beatdown Helmets 
ADDED: First-Person Legs 
ADJUSTED: Temporarily removed Australian and Brazilian servers 
ADJUSTED: Increased self-regen rate for PvP 
ADJUSTED: Mayhem has been redesigned for 24 Players 
ADJUSTED: Online Social Hubb is now Orbital Command by Default 
ADJUSTED: Assault class now has JetBoots instead of a ThrusterPack 
ADJUSTED: Completely re-did the Blinking Mechanics 
ADJUSTED: Slightly increased Boss hit points 
ADJUSTED: Polished 3rd Person Combat Shotgun animations 
FIXED: Issues with Inventory Page 2 
FIXED: Regen Laser effect on larger maps 
FIXED: Issues with being stuck while zoomed with a Regen Device 
FIXED: Egg being removed if the Carrier went out of bounds 
FIXED: Server Crash issue relating to reloading/switching items 
FIXED: Issues with inventory overlapping items 
FIXED: Pioneer status auto-awarding 

( v1.6.0 ) August 18, 2016
ADDED: Pioneer Status 
ADDED: PvP Module - Mayhem (40-Player FFA) 
ADDED: Social Hub/PvP Map - Citadel 
ADDED: Social Hub/PvP Map - Geode 
ADDED: Social Hub/PvP Map - Orbital Command 3.0 
ADDED: Trek Store Item: Blinks 
ADDED: Trek Store Item: 3-Tone Shaders 
ADDED: Trek Store Item: Tracers 
ADDED: Trek Store Item: New Helmets 
ADDED: Trek Store Item: Standard Crates 
ADDED: Trek Store Item: Inventory Upgrade 
ADDED: Weapon Skins 
ADDED: New Dinosaur - Male T-Rex ("Billy") 
ADDED: Boss Fights to PvP 
FIXED: Some Hats not being properly sized 
FIXED: Some weapons missing audio effects 
FIXED: Issues with Mouse4 not being bind-able 
ADJUSTED: Reduced Rocket Launcher splash radius in PvP 
ADJUSTED: Reduced Trek Credits from all sources 
ADJUSTED: Weapon mechanics for Magnum, Pistol and Grenade Launcher 
ADJUSTED: Guardian Classes and Armors are now separate in the Trek Store

notes.title: (First Look) NPC Module (Version 1.7)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/a60EXaa.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/n3dOwhZ.jpg[/img]

[h1] ( NPC MODULE 1.0 - Coming October 2016 ) [/h1]
We are introducing the NPC Module (1.0 integration) with the upcoming Version 1.6 scheduled to launch in October 2016.  This will include at least two NPC characters added to the game, including:

[h1]1. ADMIRAL TURIN[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/n3dOwhZ.jpg[/img]
Head of the Murdocke Militant Group (MMG) and what some would consider the right-hand man to Richard Murdocke.  Admiral Turin is completely augmented (inside and out) and is never seen wearing full battle armor due to this.  



[h1]2. ADIRA ESTON[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/a60EXaa.jpg[/img]
A smuggler or "space pirate" who set up shop on Orbital Command to attempt to make a "cleaner" living.  Formally a for-hire assassin who typically caried out tasks for the Murdocke Corporation, professionally and personally.  She is also augmented and extremely combat-capable.


[h1] ( NPC MODULE 2.0 - Coming 2017 ) [/h1]
We will be significantly growing the NPC Module via Version 2.0 when we add Orbital Command 4.0 which will feature a wide variety of NPC's, Vendors, Shops and more.  In addition other Social Hubs, including Agora and The Citadel, will also house other NPC's.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/
