notes.title: The CEL Module (Trailer)
notes.content:
We've recently announced the CEL Module for ORION. Launching in 2016!  This has been part of the Orion Lore for many years and is one of the oldest designs in the project and we finally get to experience it VERY SOON alongside you and all your friends. 

https://youtu.be/WRJQoQHEgtM

We are committed to 151 Celestial Creatures, or "CEL's" for short.  Celestials are ancient elemental creatures. They are interdimensional and can bleed between Spiritual or Spacial realms at will. 

Initially we will be launching with four types and continually adding more to the game as we develop: 
1. Draghorn (Fire) 
2. Turqle (Aqua) 
3. Ivy (Vine) 
4. NightMoth (Air) 

( THE ELEMENTAL MOON OF AGORA)
Part of the reason on why the main region on the Elemental Moon of Agora is so large is to occupy all these amazing creatures and inhabitants.

The moon of Agora is home to nearly all types of Celestials, albeit in very rare instances. 


( THE OTHER MOONS )
We are going to integrate a variety of Moons over time. Explore all of them to find valuable resources, discover Celestials and explore the secrets of Orion and the New Solar System. We are launching with the first three Moons, including: 

Each Moon has specific wildlife and climates associated to it so it’s in your best interest to travel to as many as possible. We recommend exploring with friends, just in case you counter something not so fluffy or cute: 

HOW TO CATCH? (STRONGER CELESTIALS)
Upon the first release we will have sufficient enough technology to harness the energy or "essence" of a CEL into an ION Cube. This is referred to as INDEXING and will be the main form of interaction in Celestial Module 1.0. This will be in real-time and you’ll need to make each throw count. 

HOW TO BUY? (WEAKER CELESTIALS)
You will also be able to purchase Celestials from Vendors for a price. Doing this will result in a weaker celestial than a wild catch, but can allow you to collect them in a variety of ways. This is a great way to complete your index for CEL’s you’re not directly focused on or interested in. 


( PLAY OR PAY )
Ion Cubes are extremely powerful and are extremely rare. You can PLAY for Ion Cubes (Chunks) by unlocking BONUS CRATES (PvE Side Missions), STANDARD CRATES (progression meter available to all) and ELITE CRATES (progression meter available to elite edition owners). 

More regarding the newly announced CEL Module are coming in the near future. If you have any questions please post belo

SONG: FrankieBeats - Turqle's Melody

[list]

[*] ADJUSTED: Polished 3rd Person Combat Shotgun animations
[*] FIXED: Issues with Inventory Page 2
[*] FIXED: Regen Laser effect on larger maps
[*] FIXED: Issues with being stuck while zoomed with a Regen Device

[*] FIXED: Server Crash issue relating to reloading/switching items
[*] FIXED: Issues with inventory overlapping items
[*] FIXED: Pioneer status auto-awarding
[list]


[h1]Version 1.6.2[/h1]

notes.title: CEL Module (First Look)
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/BDlaUHS.png[/img]

[h1]( THE CEL MODULE )[/h1]
We are very excited to announce the CEL Module.  This has been part of the Orion Lore for many years and is one of the oldest designs in the project and we finally get to experience it VERY SOON alongside you and all your friends.

We are committed to 151 Celestial Creatures, or "CEL's" for short.  Celestials are ancient elemental creatures.  They are interdimensional and can bleed between Spiritual or Spacial realms at will.

Initially we will be launching with four types and continually adding more to the game as we develop:
1. Draghorn (Fire) 
2. Turqle (Aqua)
3. Ivy (Vine)
4. ButterBee (Air)

[img] http://i.imgur.com/aiYxGUl.png[/img]


[h1]( THE ELEMENTAL MOON OF AGORA) [/h1]
Part of the reason on why the main region on the Elemental Moon of Agora is so large is to occupy all these amazing creatures and inhabitants.  
https://youtu.be/8fOCADz6IeA
The moon of Agora is home to nearly all types of Celestials, albeit in very rare instances.


[h1]( THE OTHER MOONS )[/h1]
We are going to integrate a variety of Moons over time.  Explore all of them to find valuable resources, discover Celestials and explore the secrets of Orion and the New Solar System. We are launching with the first three Moons, including:

[img] http://i.imgur.com/T9FYVeD.png[/img]
[img] http://i.imgur.com/lxRIYoX.png[/img]
[img] http://i.imgur.com/DRJV2Ls.png[/img]

Each Moon has specific wildlife and climates associated to it so it’s in your best interest to travel to as many as possible.  We recommend exploring with friends, just in case you counter something not so fluffy or cute:
https://youtu.be/FL_gbwxrD4c


[h1]HOW TO CATCH? (STRONGER CELESTIALS)[/h1]
Upon the first release we will have sufficient enough technology to harness the energy or "essence" of a CEL into an ION Cube.  This is referred to as INDEXING and will be the main form of interaction in Celestial Module 1.0.  This will be in real-time and you’ll need to make each throw count.

[h1]HOW TO BUY? (WEAKER CELESTIALS)[/h1]
You will also be able to purchase Celestials from Vendors for a price.  Doing this will result in a weaker celestial than a wild catch, but can allow you to collect them in a variety of ways.  This is a great way to complete your index for CEL’s you’re not directly focused on or interested in.


[h1]( PLAY OR PAY )[/h1]
Ion Cubes are extremely powerful and are extremely rare.  You can PLAY for Ion Cubes (Chunks) by unlocking BONUS CRATES (PvE Side Missions), STANDARD CRATES (progression meter available to all) and ELITE CRATES (progression meter available to elite edition owners).

More regarding the newly announced CEL Module are coming in the near future.  If you have any questions please post below in the comments for us to curate and address in following updates.

notes.title: Trek August 2016 Update (F2P Canned)
notes.content:
[h1]( THE ORION PROJECT )[/h1]
The ORION Project is a Sci-Fi Shooter featuring Dinosaurs and Robots and it's focused on Accessibility, Over-The-Top Gameplay, Power Ups, Local & Online Co-Op, Social Hubs, Destruction and more! ORION is the successor to the multi-platinum indie hit: ORION: Prelude.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

https://youtu.be/W9bvRGv9J3U

[h1]( PRELUDE IS FREE! )[/h1]
Play our first game, ORION: Prelude for FREE!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900

https://youtu.be/2Uu0C359l9Y

[h1]( VERSION 1.6.0 PREVIEW BUILD )[/h1]
We recently released a preview version of 1.6.0 to gain additional feedback and information pertaining to what is the largest content update to the game yet!  Thanks to all who participated and submitted feedback as this helped us squash many issues before the big debut.

https://youtu.be/xsUEmzpVzg0

We had a few issues arise once going public and the biggest two issues related to the Automatic Shotgun (server crashing bug) and another issue related to Inventory/Slots.  

[h1]( INVENTORY REPAIR )[/h1]
To repair the crafting/resource issue we are expecting to do an ION bonus to all users who played during that period.  This will be applied in the full release of v1.6.0 coming in the first week of September 2016.

[h1]( v1.6.0p BETA TESTING )[/h1]
If you wish to continue helping us test and find any other anomalies please contact us via:
iwanttohelp@trek-industries.com

[h1]( PREMIUM PRELUDE HELMETS )[/h1]
This is integrated and ready.  We are only waiting on one change from Steams end and when applied these will redeem in your 1.6.0 game build.

[h1]( SOME RECENT CHANGES )[/h1]
Initially were were going to delay the F2P edition to coincide with Version 1.7 in September 2016 once the 1.6.0p issues started to appear.  This would allow us to further polish and even add new content (Guardian, Dino, Weapon, etc) to celebrate.  

However we were recently contacted by one of our development partners stating that our back end services were going to cost more going forward.  They are doing this towards all of their clients as they referenced they need to make their business more efficient.  

In addition to the price hike it appears that many aspects of how things will work will be changing or modified and have a new cost associated.  This was unexpected on our end and affects some of our immediate plans greatly.  Notably the F2P edition.   I am OK with a little risk, but not risk in every direction and there are too many variables that are now unknown.  

[h1]( F2P EDITION CANCELLED )[/h1]
As of this update the F2P edition of The Orion Project is cancelled until further notice as we will need to re-evaluate not only our partner, but the backend itself as well as look into other options to ensure these types of surprises and changes don't happen in the future.  

[h1]( PIONEER STATUS / ELITE STATUS + ION )[/h1]
If you had an issue with not receiving ION from from a Pioneer Status transaction this will be resolved in the 1.6.0 update in Sept 2016.  If you have an issue with Elite ION this will be resolved in August 2016.

[h1]( XBOX ONE GIVEAWAY )[/h1]
Your chance at a FREE Xbox One!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F6BoF1bF_aw

[h1]( FOLLOW OUR DEVELOPMENT ON TWITCH.TV )[/h1]
https://www.twitch.tv/dprassel

Any questions?
connect@trek-industries.com

notes.title: Version 1.6.0 - Preview Released
notes.content:
[h1]( VERSION 1.6.0 - NOW AVAILABLE! )[/h1]
We have released v1.6.0 early to gain additional wide-spread feedback and server information.    

The PvP Module is integrated for the first time in the for of MAYHEM, a 40-Player FFA game mode that has you killing enemies, tackling objectives and completing quests - all while earning real credits and experience!

The PvP Modules at this time are UNRANKED.  Skills and Gear are not applied as this is purely "vanilla" ORION PvP.


[h1]( VERSION 1.6.0 - CHANGELOG )[/h1]
[list]
[*] ADDED: Pioneer Status
[*] ADDED: PvP Module - Mayhem (40-Player FFA)
[*] ADDED: Social Hub/PvP Map - Citadel
[*] ADDED: Social Hub/PvP Map - Geode
[*] ADDED: Social Hub/PvP Map - Orbital Command 3.0
[*] ADDED: Trek Store Item: Blinks
[*] ADDED: Trek Store Item: 3-Tone Shaders
[*] ADDED: Trek Store Item: Tracers
[*] ADDED: Trek Store Item: New Helmets
[*] ADDED: Trek Store Item: Standard Crates
[*] ADDED: Trek Store Item: Inventory Upgrade
[*] ADDED: Weapon Skins
[*] ADDED: New Dinosaur - Male T-Rex ("Billy")
[*] ADDED: Boss Fights to PvP
[*] FIXED: Some Hats not being properly sized
[*] FIXED: Some weapons missing audio effects
[*] FIXED: Issues with Mouse4 not being bind-able
[*] ADJUSTED: Reduced Rocket Launcher splash radius in PvP
[*] ADJUSTED: Reduced Trek Credits from all sources
[*] ADJUSTED: Weapon mechanics for Magnum, Pistol and Grenade Launcher
[*] ADJUSTED: Guardian Classes and Armors are now separate in the Trek Store
[/list]

[h1]( VERSION 1.6.0 - WARNING )[/h1]
This was a major version update and technical issues are expected.  This build is highly experimental.  Please report any discoveries to:
bugs@trek-industries.com


[h1]( CRASH FIX - COMING SOON! )[/h1]
There is a Pyro-related bug that is crashing PvE/PvP servers.  We are currently looking into this and will resolve it as soon as possible.  If we can not resolve it soon we will revert back to 1.5.5.4 temporarily as we iron this out internally.  If you have any specific information that you believe pertains to us feel free to connect with us directly:
connect@trek-industries.com

notes.content:
https://youtu.be/doXZChq2wt8

[h1]( MAYHEM PVP )[/h1]
40-Player FFA (Free-For-All) PvP Gameplay where every player kill grants 1 Store Credit.  This mode also features World Events that will change gameplay and offer ways to earn even more Store Credits!

[quote]
This video teaser depicts one of the world events that can occur during a Mayhem PvP match.  This quest has a wild male T-Rex appear and unlike other Players who only grant you 1 Store Credit per Kill, a boss kill like this grants a percentile (based on damage) of 100 Store Credits!

So when you see a World Event like this make sure to head to it and claim your reward!
[/quote]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

notes.title: Let's Talk F2P
notes.content:
We wanted to cover the F2P model coming to ORION in Version 1.6 (August 2016) as in depth as possible.  If you find that you still have questions once done reading this, feel free to contact us directly at:
f2p@trek-industries.com

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=woVwB0Zps7w


[h1]YOU'RE STILL SPECIAL[/h1]
So the most important thing to convey is that ALL existing owners, aka ANYONE that Plays or Logs Online *before* August 25, 2016 - will be automatically upgraded into a PREMIUM model member.  We have a variety of new models coming to the game, including the F2P model, all launching with Version 1.6.

[h1]F2P EDITION IS SEPARATE[/h1]
The Free-2-Play edition of ORION is a brand new model and does not replace the $1 version.  The Free-2-Play edition of ORION only features one starting Guardian, while everything about the $1 version remains the same.

[h1]THANK YOU[/h1]
In addition, the $1 Premium Model will have content *added* to it in order for us to say thank you for your support.  We are creating a Premium Armor Set and Premium Helmet which will be rewarded FREE to ALL Premium Model Members, including ALL owners of the game prior to August 25, 2016.


[h1]THE EDITIONS OF ORION (AUG 2016)[/h1]
Here is a breakdown of all editions of the game scheduled to launch in Version 1.6/August 25, 2016:
[quote]
[b]FREE (F2P) EDITION[/b]
· 1 Starting Guardian (Assault) 

[b]$1 PREMIUM EDITION[/b]
· 3 Starting Guardians (Assault, Support, Recon) 
· Premium Armor Set 
· 500,000 ION 

[b]$10 ORIGINS EDITION[/b]
· 5 Starting Guardians (Assault, Support, Recon, Tech, Demo) 
· Premium Armor Set 
· Premium Helmet 
· Origins Helmet 
· 1,000,000 ION 

[b]$25 GOLD EDITION[/b]
· Access to 10 Guardians 
· Premium Armor Set 
· Premium Helmet 
· Origins Helmet 
· Gold Helmet 
· Gold Armor Skin 
· Gold Weapon Skin* 
· 3,000,000 ION 

[b]$50 PLATINUM EDITION[/b]
· Access to 15 Guardians 
· Premium Armor Set 
· Premium Helmet 
· Origins Helmet 
· Gold Helmet 
· Platinum Helmet 
· Gold Armor Skin 
· Gold Weapon Skin* 
· Platinum Armor Skin 
· Platinum Weapon Skin* 
· 5,000,000 ION 

[b]$100 ELITE EDITION[/b]
· EliteXP/Elite Loot Crates (Unlock focus instead of microtransaction)
· Access to 20 Guardians 
· 50% Store Discount (For Life) 
· Exclusive Elite Armor 
· Exclusive Elite Helmet 
· Exclusive Elite Trench Coat 
· Exclusive Elite Pet (T.O.D) 
· Premium Armor Set 
· Premium Helmet 
· Origins Helmet 
· Gold Helmet 
· Platinum Helmet 
· Gold Armor Skin 
· Gold Weapon Skin* 
· Platinum Armor Skin 
· Platinum Weapon Skin* 
· 10,000,000 ION 

[i]* - Weapon Skins coming in FPS Module 2, alongside Weapon Attachments, Weapon Customization, Weapon Skins, ADS (Aim-Down-Sights) and more. Scheduled for 2017.[/i]
[/quote]
To add to this, if you already own the ELITE EDITION or are a FOUNDER or are a FOUNDER ELITE - nothing changes for you.  You simply also get the new Premium Armor Set and Premium Armor Helmet for FREE as well.  In addition, with us increasing focus towards the store (without hampering core game focus) you will now have even more players to play with and more store items to use your 50% eternal store discount on.

So to sum it up, absolutely nothing changes for ANY existing user, whether $1 or Elite/Founder.  You are in fact receiving MORE and we are simply offering new ways for NEW players to get into the game.


[h1]WAS F2P ALWAYS THE PLAN?[/h1]
When we initially approached very early versions of ORION, in the form of Guardians of Orion (when it was just a top-down, twin-stick shooter) we initially were simply going to create a standard game, with the ability to transform it into what we really wanted which was a project many have known about for years - The ORION Project, or ORION for short. 

We ended up getting motivated to expand and announced that and it's associated name change in early 2016. Once it became that larger, longer-term experience we always knew it would go towards at least the $1 model. Guardians of Orion was even considered to launch as F2P in some early designs, but ultimately we didn't want to have a store focus early in development and instead wanted to focus on REAL game content. Something that still remains a priority. 

We've been testing a potential F2P model all the way back to 2013 with ORION: Dino Horde.  We've been seeing what events can do, price changes, sales/discounts as well as in-game stores.  After 3 years of tests we are happy to say that we believe that ORION will not only survive F2P, but that it will thrive.


[h1]WHAT ABOUT PAY-2-WIN?[/h1]
Never.  Nothing about the game model is changing, other than new entry points with differing content.  We are still 100% behind PLAY or PAY with the current system setup and this will only improve as we grow the store and ways for you to earn credits for the store through playing.

We will never go Pay-2-Win.  That is a promise. If things ever got to a point where it was so bad, I would simply revert back to a premium game ($1) before ever making a ♥♥♥♥♥♥, greedy, f2p/p2w game. 


[h1]WHAT ABOUT PAY WALLS?[/h1]
Nothing is changing, including our stance on Pay Walls.  There will never be a wall between you and friends, no matter which versions of the game you're on.  

In addition, if one friend owns a Raid Mission they can invite non-owning Friends to play.  No Pay Walls, at all.


[h1]WHAT ABOUT A POTENTIALLY TOXIC COMMUNITY?[/h1]
Rest assured, our $1 model was used to test this. $1 is a lot easier for people to get (or 50 cents for that matter) than $60 and we have one of the best communities I have ever seen, across both ORION and ORION: Prelude - both of which are $1 titles. 

What that means is that it is EASIER for our games to have a toxic community, just on entry alone. But that is NOT the case and that is courtesy of work and things we do to ensure it. 


[h1]WHAT ABOUT PEOPLE CREATING "SMURF" ACCOUNTS?[/h1]
Considering the game will be F2P, this is of course possible.  However starting with Level 0 Guardians and no gear, especially 2-3 times will break down any sort of troll very fast.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840

Want more information?   Read the FULL F2P FAQ:
http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791440487256/announcements/detail/814405855455318273

notes.title: Our Plan Of Attack
notes.content:
So after some consideration I've decided on how to approach this going forward.  

https://youtu.be/woVwB0Zps7w

To remedy as many things as possible in the immediate:

1. We're going to remove ANY and ALL assets from the artist involved in this weeks event, including any remaining assets in the game that don't have any reports associated.  When time is available, we will investigate these both internally and with the community and if they are determined to be genuine and fresh we will be able to re-integrate these at a later date.  

2. I am going to use assets from ORION: Prelude to repair any damages done here.  These are assets we legally own and it will not require us to invest additional money into these damages and will allow us to have the assets we need in place until we can replace them at a later, much more convenient date. 

3. We are going to see if the 3D Art Team responsible for the Prelude assets is available for more development work and they would be handling Vehicles/Weapons moving forward. connect@trek-industries.com

notes.title: We Have More To Share [UPDATED]
notes.content:
This situation has somehow just become even more bizarre.  Not many emails put me into shock but I literally had my jaw drop when I received an email yesterday.  With all these events stacked, I simply cannot keep quiet.  

While I will share these details, I was originally not going to name shame anyone, including the artist involved - but with all of these events along with waking up today, he's done too many malicious things to myself, our product, everyone on the team that *does* work their ass off - and has already been fired as mentioned. 

His name is Binh Le
https://www.artstation.com/artist/binhle

Starting off, I want to share these three chat logs.  While the artist initially was helpful, offering to remake the asset at no cost, he went quiet shortly after and became uncooperative and wouldn't inform us of any of the other assets that may have infringed.  

There were OTHER assets that infringed that the public was unaware of, these are the same assets privately sent to me by Activision in which convinced me immediately that the artist involved was in the wrong and it was a blatant rip.  This included our Sniper Rifle, Burst Rifle and Rocket Launcher.  Chat logs below, Dates/time-stamps all available:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/OfKeDVw.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/r1HfNjz.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/REPF41Q.jpg[/img]


[h1]( WEIRDEST APPLICATION EVER )[/h1]
Now I just received an yesterday from a 3D artist applying for a job.  This was not a typical application:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zcmlWXv.jpg[/img]
[quote]
[i]"Let me get straight to the point (I'll be honest with you guys. It's risky but I'll do it anyway):
I'm very sorry for your recent trouble and congrats on getting your game back on Steam. Though you don't know me but I'm the artist who worked on the Light Mech and the Blaster gun you've just received few days ago."[/i]
[/quote]

In short, the artist who was responsible for all violating assets against Activision was also outsourcing assets to other artists unknowingly to us, acting as if was creating these.  This was something that'd be extremely hard to detect as he would regularly send work-in-progress images for feedback acting as if he was creating it as expected:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/GMkGztw.jpg[/img]

This shocked me for quite a bit.  Never expected this, way larger than ever anticipated.  He was not only taking Trek funds but paying them less and pocketing the rest.

This sent me into a research frenzy to learn as much as I could and I started going through years of documentation and information.  This included all the way back to Spiral Game Studios mailing, from 2012-2013.


[h1]( LET'S GET STARTED )[/h1]
I cannot confirm that Binh Le and TIn Le are the same person but at minimum they are connected in some form.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uLctsgd.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nshcJ3a.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/WqjvEjm.jpg[/img]

Tin Le was removed in the past (Aug 6, 2014) for submitting stolen content, relating to VFX work.  You can read about that here:
https://www.facebook.com/trekindustries/posts/785489094816049

[b]*UPDATED*[/b]
While I cannot say it with absolute certainty, I believe that Tin Le and Binh Le are the same person.  Regardless, they/he has begun removing information, such as the artstation link.  I simply don't want this to happen to anyone else and I have uploaded any information related to them/him that I have to prevent such.  Resume/Cover Letters below:

[url=https://mega.nz/#!pFpDQCgT!doHoDYBDlMAuFnykIEDJR8lNvM1HYHSbLmhaEdJiUzM]Tin Le Resume[/url]
[url=https://mega.nz/#!VIJk0TIT!se9a3QK8E9UqCcim_Sh2BiJsWrRzLzEFPn4JFmKRwQI]Tin Le Portfolio[/url]
[url=https://mega.nz/#!VNxC3BzZ!F31SLgAUDrZtQMcEmDEW5KRXkXAsl18gbhyiMM_B9Aw]Binh Le Portflio[/url]
[url=https://mega.nz/#!ZQ4TXQTL!kWT0lJTsfYWGDTODcT1_Pwav8Z0h-QRdjcOPeO0TdTk]Binh Le Resume[/url]


In addition to all of this, we woke up today to a user submitting another incident of infraction, relating to an asset created by Binh Le which is related to our newer Harvesting unit.  You can read more about that thread here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/407840/discussions/0/351660338715884928/

[h1] ( FIXING AS FAST AS POSSIBLE )[/h1]
When waking up today and seeing this its obvious that is also an infraction.  This unit is also being removed from the game as fast as we can.  The problem is we upgraded the entire engine yesterday (4.12.4) to include a new version from Epic.  

This has some really nice optimizations but doing an entire engine upgrade is sort of like open heart surgery and putting out a patch so soon is very scary as there could be lots of elements still needing love from said port.


[h1] ( LOOKING FOR HELP ) [/h1]
We are currently working on addressing all of this but everyone here simply wants to get back to work and normality and any support anyone can provide in this time is much appreciated.  

This is far more severe than I imagined and we are looking for genuine 3D artists to assist us in remaking these assets and catching up.  This is of course paid work, just asking for help.  Contact directly if able at:
connect@trek-industries.com


[h1]( THE SHORT VERSION )[/h1]
In the end, for anyone not in the industry to understand - these freelancers cost Trek thousands to potentially hundreds of thousands of dollars in damages, ranging from actual investments towards tasks/content that is now trash - all the way to who that content has to be "touched" by, and for 3D content that includes Rigging/Skeletons by the Technical Team, Animation Sets by the Animation team, and Integration by the Programming team including Shader/Bones/Origins and more. 

[b]All of this content, people or time costs money and all of that content is now trash.[/b]

In addition to that it removed the game during the largest event of the year, causing significant damages. That is in addition to having to spend all of our times and resources now editing/deleting images, redoing entire trailers and having other talent who are supposed to be working on OTHER content come and do backwards development to repair all affected assets. In addition, we are hiring MORE talent (more costs) to assist in this.

TL;DR:
Don't hire these people.

notes.title: Orion/Call of Duty - Resolution Reached
notes.content:
A resolution has finally been reached.  Everything remains true, including:
01. I received the DMCA request after its removal from Steam with no warning/contact from either Valve/Steam or any developer associated with Call of Duty nor anyone from Activision. 

02. I never was provided specific examples of assets, or screenshots of what offended them - nor given the chance to rectify or remove any offensive content prior to having our game removed from sale.  This took 72 hours, of which I was both unable to externally resolve the situation for fans/product, nor investigate internally.

03. We assumed which pieces of content based on what they self-labeled from their Call of Duty games as well as community-provided assets:
http://i.imgur.com/8Qx1NI2.png 
http://i.imgur.com/IjS7dfO.png 
http://i.imgur.com/ZQeBNGs.png 

04. I was informed by Steam that according to their policy, Activision had 10 business days (until mid-July) to act or do anything.  If Steam didn't receive a copy of a legal complaint within 10 business days, then our game would be re-instated.  We immediately offered to remove ANY offensive content (it wasn't specified) and this was NOT accepted.


[h1]( THE LARGER PICTURE )[/h1]
Not providing any specific information, both in the DMCA that brought the game down as well as in multiple instances of correspondence between both parties - is prevented any of us from finding a solution or to learn more about what was going on.  This costed massive damages.  All that being said, that is simply a minor inconvenience in the grand scheme of things given what I learned yesterday directly from Activision.

I am now in complete compliance with their complaint and I am equally as mad.  While I don't agree simply based on the evidence that you are all going on about, relating to our Auto Shotgun - I do see similarities in the sights/bolts, etc.  I don't believe it was important enough to remedy immediately, affecting production on all ends to simply replace that one weapon when we could just do it later on.  We acted under the pretense this was the only infraction/issue.  This was not the case.  Regardless, I understand that was a unique perspective and that many in the community and even on the team agreed for it to go.  In the end, it WAS removed from the game and will be made public in the upcoming Version 1.5.5.

Last night I received evidence directly from Activision regarding assets not even mentioned in public yet.  Upon receiving this it became immediately apparent that blatant rips were made.  While the artist offered to remake any assets at no cost, he has now been fired immediately upon learning this.  This will slightly affect production and I will get into that later.


[h1]( WE ARE REMOTE )[/h1]
What most users don't understand is that we are a remote developer, we don't work side-by-side.  Hiring and full-time development happens online in different time zones and different hours of the day.  This can result in situations like this and we do are best to avoid them.

What most users also don't understand is that I personally don't build these weapons.  I am not a 3D artist, at all.  I am responsible for anything from the business, to making the maps/worlds, and making sure the product comes together. What I am responsible for is hiring the individual responsible.  And this is what concerns me the most: I cannot guarantee this will be prevented in the future.  I don't get to play other games, I am working on this full-time.  I would never have the chance at cross-checking content across every game nor could I be expected to.  This is why we are open to fan submissions or even developer ones like this.  If there is valid proof, we will remove it immediately.

There weren't and usually aren't any tell-signs, especially with situations like this where he had a great, valid portfolio (establishment proof).  He completed a variety of valid, great assets (physical work proof) and responded appropriately when presented with the information and offering to remedy it at no cost (personality).  It would get through the hiring process any time and the ONLY way I can see preventing it is setting up a physical studio.  But even that is not true as it's fully possible to do this in a studio all-the-same.

The problem is I can't stomach that simply to be able to have security on people and ensuring they are working when the majority of everyone here DOES incredible work and we are more than capable of being able to be remotely, in our home countries near our friends and families - or doing things like we want on my end which is travel the world and really take in the areas we are building.


[h1]( FAN SERVICE )[/h1]
I also understand that outside users with no relationship to the game or having played it could be confused by our level of fan service.  This IS different as I do instruct artists to not only create unique things like custom sets of armors, but to also do their own takes on other properties either they, we, or you guys love.  They are vastly different than the source material, but you are intended to know what it's paying tribute to.  In addition to this, I personally pay for custom helmets to be produced by artists FOR the developers to use as their own personal developer helmet, never to be sold.  It's a gift/thanks of sorts and allows us to have a fun unique experience.  This includes helmets like Fettuccine (my 2014 helmet), Kilo Reno (my current helmet), Ganga (Programmers helmet), and Star King (Animator's helmet).

I understand that simply seeing that in image form, from the outside, would be confusing.  It never came from a malicious place, and I only was attempting to do something cool for the people I work with as well as cater to what you all loved prior to and after Orion.  This won't be happening anymore as it's just added risk for what is ultimately no reward.  All content from this point going forward will be unique - as unique as you can get when doing hundreds to thousands of sci fi armor/helmet pieces.


[h1]( BLAST FROM THE PAST )[/h1]
With this unfortunate event, a lot of the insane stuff of the past started to appear again and it's not fair to those users involved as those events were not malicious as this one was, nor were the freelancers behind it.  I've seen comments about Natural Selection, Primal Carnage, Counter-Strike and Achievement Images, all of which have been commented on in the past and only one I am directly responsible for.

@NATURAL SELECTION 2 ARMOR
This related to a development-only, pre-alpha game build. We were flying to conferences like Gamescom (Germany) and Eurogamer (London) to show to publishers and press. At the time, like any developer, you use whatever content and assets you have access to in order to mock up the experience. We had a freelancer at the time, Daniel Doerksen who was simply a fan of Unknown Worlds/Natural Selection - never officially worked for them and simply made himself personal portfolio piece based on their art. At this time we needed a unit exactly the same (a dispenser that grants ammo) and used what he had legally available to do so. It was caught in a few frames in a trailer and people (somehow) assumed it was straight from the Natural Selection 2 game, a title that wasn't even released to the public at that time. The model was subbed out for the official release, as always intended.

@PRIMAL CARNAGE ARTWORK
Another incident involved a freelancing concept artist. Back in the day we had an additional folder on our shared Dropbox called "Mood Art". This would contain anything that was either very "Orionish" or something I wanted to get added to the game and consisted of Orion-related fan art, things we'd find online. Said artist utilized a piece of artwork from that folder and used it as a base layer, proportionally, to do a full new drawing on top of.   When submitted to me, I didn't know this at the time. However Ashton, the former head of Primal contacted me right after we made the news post and we took it down immediately and apologized right then and I also personally apologized in person at a conference. They did not accept it. Fun fact, years later the two Dinosaur 3D Artists, Tim M and Eugen T, would join and create the Dinosaurs for both Prelude and most of Guardians of Orion.

@COUNTER-STRIKE AUDIO
Either stock or mod counter-strike audio was used in the game on accident and immediately removed.  Can't even remember what sound it was, I think the mp5.

@ACHIEVEMENT IMAGES
This is the one I am guilty of.  We are a small team.  We don't have a dedicated Graphic Designer, Sound Designer or User Interface Artist.  We want those spots filled, just haven't found anyone proper to fill them.  So when it comes time to do things like UI it's just me and the Programmer and whatever we can hack/mock up.  This is my shitty image design, of which I used google images for things we were referencing, such as Turok.  I understand looking back this was wrong and once it was brought up to us it was immediately removed.  It actually worked out as the people who ended up doing the Achievement art found out about us from that situation.  They make Race The Sun on Steam.  They helped in a time of need, they are great workers and it's a great game and you should support them.


[h1]( WE FIRED PEOPLE )[/h1]
This is the name of the game. We work remotely and independently, so sometimes talent doesn't work out. However it wasn't purely related to strangers and anyone that steals or tries to steal hardware, money or do other shady things doesn't have a place at Trek. More on that here:
http://artistryingames.com/spiraling-control-incredible-journey-spiral-game-studios/


[h1]( OUR APPROACH ) [/h1]
So where does this leave us?  Well the team is extremely upset, I feel like an idiot with what was presented to me.  That's just how you go about it though, you treat your devs like children and have their back until proven otherwise.  He is from all the way around the world in Vietnam and so communication was delayed and then ultimately not receiving any at all from his end.  In the end, he let everyone here down and we simply just need to get to work and focus on the game.

So what can I do to assume what is ultimately my responsibility?  
1. We are removing ANY content that Activision finds offensive, immediately.
2. I am removing ALL DevHelmets from the game.  This includes Fettuccine which we gave away to all users for free. 
3. Other artists within the team have volunteered to remedy any assets required to restore the game to its quickest state as fast as possible.
4. We are shutting down social media.  I don't find the results from when it's positive large enough, and when it gets bad it's just horrible.  We really need to bunker down to catch up on what was removed and we just want to focus on the game and will continue to do so and post updates/interactions to orion-project.net OR are YouTube which will remain operational:

As always if you want to connect or if you have anything to suggest/report you can always contact us directly:
connect@trek-industries.com

Thank you for all who supported us during this time, and ultimately thank you to all of those who reported this.  In the end it helped reveal something which would have only affected the game more negatively over time.  This situation is embarrassing and sucks very much but it's for the best.


[h1]( IN SHORT )[/h1]
It will be over today/tomorrow.
Version 1.5.5 addresssing said issues is expected to release in 1-2 hours as of this post.
Should be back on sale today/tomorrow.
It will take a lot of time and work, but we've done it before.
I am stressed but it will be fine.

GG
-David

tags.feature: In the end, it WAS removed from the game and will be made public in the upcoming Version 1.5.5.

[h1]( OUR APPROACH ) [/h1]
So where does this leave us?  Well the team is extremely upset, I feel like an idiot with what was presented to me.  That's just how you go about it though, you treat your devs like children and have their back until proven otherwise.  He is from all the way around the world in Vietnam and so communication was delayed and then ultimately not receiving any at all from his end.  In the end, he let everyone here down and we simply just need to get to work and focus on the game.

So what can I do to assume what is ultimately my responsibility?  
1. We are removing ANY content that Activision finds offensive, immediately.
2. I am removing ALL DevHelmets from the game.  This includes Fettuccine which we gave away to all users for free. 
3. Other artists within the team have volunteered to remedy any assets required to restore the game to its quickest state as fast as possible.
4. We are shutting down social media.  I don't find the results from when it's positive large enough, and when it gets bad it's just horrible.  We really need to bunker down to catch up on what was removed and we just want to focus on the game and will continue to do so and post updates/interactions to orion-project.net OR are YouTube which will remain operational:

As always if you want to connect or if you have anything to suggest/report you can always contact us directly:
connect@trek-industries.com

Thank you for all who supported us during this time, and ultimately thank you to all of those who reported this.  In the end it helped reveal something which would have only affected the game more negatively over time.  This situation is embarrassing and sucks very much but it's for the best.


[h1]( IN SHORT )[/h1]
It will be over today/tomorrow.
Version 1.5.5 addresssing said issues is expected to release in 1-2 hours as of this post.
Should be back on sale today/tomorrow.
It will take a lot of time and work, but we've done it before.
I am stressed but it will be fine.

GG
-David

notes.title: Our Official Response
notes.content:
[h1]The Facts[/h1]
I received the DCMA request after its removal from Steam with no warning/contact from either Valve/Steam or any developer associated with Call of Duty nor anyone from Activision.

I never was provided specific examples of assets, or screenshots of what offended them - nor given the chance to rectify or remove any offensive content prior to having our game removed from sale.

We assumed which pieces of content based on what they self-labeled of their own as well as community-provided assets.

(Comparison 1 - Auto Shotgun)
http://i.imgur.com/8Qx1NI2.png
(Comparison 2 - Auto Rifle)
http://i.imgur.com/IjS7dfO.png

http://i.imgur.com/ZQeBNGs.png

We immediately offered to remove ANY offensive content (as it wasn't specified) and this was not accepted.  


[h1]The Events[/h1]
I was informed by Steam that accordingly to their policy, Activision has 10 business days (until July 7th, 2016 - basically a month due to the Holiday) to act or do anything.  

If Steam doesn't receive a copy of a legal complaint within 10 business days, then our game will be re-instated.

What this means is that Activision has maliciously and erroneously used a DMCA request to aggressively attack a small, independent development team during the BIGGEST Sale Event of the entire year, the Steam Summer Sale.


[h1]Our Comments[/h1]
The sight is the only similarity we can see. Even if it was a 1:1, that's not enough for a design infraction, even by legal standards and by a significant amount.

http://i.imgur.com/ZQeBNGs.png

And the sight is just a futuristic M1 Garand, so either way both are homaging a real world property, the only thing that could actually hold up and is the only one without a dog in this fight.

Regardless, an invalid and malicious act from Activision on wrong or non-existant evidence. They are are multi-billion dollar company coming over what is currently a 50 cent game, without contacting us or requesting anything of us NOR providing any specific assets or images of the offensive content to begin with

That being said, if our community finds our weapons or content offensive we are of course always listening and will integrate feedback/suggestions based on such. If you want weapons changed, we are a developer that reads what you write. We've demonstrated this for many years now across a variety of products:

ORION
https://youtu.be/BbL9MioMpF8

ORION: Prelude
https://youtu.be/ShQ3GBFI4KQ


The Non-Specific DMCA:
DMCA Takedown Notice on your item
 
Valve received a DMCA copyright take down notice about your game, Orion, on Steam at http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/. 
[quote]
*REDACTED*, on behalf of Activision, alleges that the game Orion uses weapon art content from Call of Duty: Black Ops 3 and Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.  The weapon art in question includes the M8A7 rifle, the Haymaker rifle, and the Bal-27 rifle.  Use of this weapon art content without permission infringes Activision’s copyright in Call of Duty: Black Ops 3 and Call of Duty:  Advanced Warfare. https://www.activision.com/games/call-of-duty/call-of-duty-black-ops-3,https://www.activision.com/games/call-of-duty/call-of-duty-advanced-warfare.

As a result, we have removed your posting from Steam.  

Valve follows the procedure set forth in the Digital Millennium Copyright Act. The DMCA is a United States copyright law that governs online service provider liability in case of copyright infringement.  When we receive a DMCA notice, Valve must take down allegedly infringing copyright materials; otherwise Valve could be subject to a claim of copyright infringement.[/quote]


[h1]In Short[/h1]
Orion is a game all about homages.  It's what it's always been, since it was announced as a retro homage to the classic 90's games with a modern take.  It’s GI Joes action figures versus your Jurassic Park toys. It’s Halo meets Turok.  It's what we all did as kids in our heads.

I just can’t believe of all things, it was over a generic sci-fi weapon. Regardless what it was over, the most important thing was that we were not warned, contacted by either party nor able to remedy it. We were given no specific information relating to assets, only left to guess or use fan-submitted content/links to decipher.

We offered immediately to remove any offensive content right off the bat, this was rejected.

We are happy to read any feedback about the game. Any ORION fan knows we do this regularly. We are always reading and listening and if fans find any of our content offensive we have and will always replace it.


[h1]A Warning[/h1]
[quote]
To any website reporting false claims with no verifiable proof or facts regarding myself or Trek - this is not acceptable and won't be tolerated.  

You can not flat out lie about people.  That is slander and defamation.  We've seen two reports pop up from over 5 years ago.  tt wasn't true then, still isn't now.

To anyone spreading claims without proof, we will be seeking resolution once we're done addressing  what we're going to do with Activision.


( NATURAL SELECTION 2 ARMORY )
This related to a development-only, pre-alpha game build.  We were flying to conferences like Gamescom (Germany) and Eurogamer (London) to show to publishers and press.  At the time, like any developer, you use whatever content and assets you have access to in order to mock up the experience.  We had a freelancer at the time, Daniel Doerksen who was simply a fan of Unknown Worlds/Natural Selection - never officially worked for them and simply made himself  personal portfolio piece based on their art.  

At this time we needed a unit exactly the same (a dispenser that grants ammo) and used what he had legally available to do so.  It was caught in a few frames in a trailer and people (somehow) assumed it was straight from the Natural Selection 2 game, a title that wasn't even released to the public at that time.  The model was subbed out for the official release, as always intended.


(PRIMAL CARNAGE ARTWORK)
Another incident involved a freelancing concept artist.  Back in the day we had an additional folder on our shared Dropbox called "Mood Art".  This would contain anything that was either very "Orionish" or something I wanted to get added to the game and consisted of orion-related fan art, things we'd find online.  Said artist utilized a piece of artwork from that folder and used it as a base layer, proportionally, to do a full new drawing on top of.  

When submitted to me, I didn't know this at the time.  However Ashton, the former head of Primal contacted me right after we made the news post and we took it down immediately and apologized right then and I also personally apologized in person at a conference.  They did not accept it.  Fun fact, years later the two Dinosaur 3D Artists, Tim M and Eugen T, would join and create the Dinosaurs for both Prelude and most of Guardians of Orion - only for me to find out that they were having payment issues at Lukewarm for their completed content.


(WE FIRED PEOPLE)
This is the name of the game.  We work remotely and independently, so sometimes talent doesn't work out.  However it wasn't purely related to strangers and anyone that steals or tries to steal hardware, money or do other shady things doesn't have a place at Trek.  More on that here:
http://artistryingames.com/spiraling-control-incredible-journey-spiral-game-studios/
[/quote]


[h1]An Update[/h1]
An additional update is available. For the record, I (-David) don't agree with this nor believe it's a good use of a small teams resources to immediately replace any asset. 

I was just contacted by the artist responsible (he just woke up to all of this - Eastern part of the world) for the Automatic Shotgun (which is what appears most in fans-submitted comparisons) feels absolutely horrible and has contacted me to inform me that he would feel more comfortable in remaking said weapon regardless of what I do about Activision or how we proceed. So no matter what happens going forward, that weapon will be visually different. 

He feels terrible that his piece of art resulted in these events that have affected so many things and he has started production on it this evening to remedy anything he can do directly. 

- - - - - 

In the end, what Activision is claiming isn't a valid or legal use of DMCA.  If they were alleging that we had actually RIPPED the Black Ops 3 weapons FROM their game and used them exactly - their shipped meshes, their shipped textures - that is a DMCA case.

What they are alleging is that our very own, separately created content is "too visually" or "artistically similar".  That is *NOT* what the DMCA covers.  That is a form of copyright and IP infringement dispute.  Their lawyers know this, but filed this anyways. 

We will be seeking resolution for all damages wrongly inflicted by us FROM Activision via this malicious and overly aggressive tactic.  

Our desire to remove said content is purely for our own benefit. We are a small indie team, any minute the game is not for sale during the biggest event is a stake to the heart.  Us willing to remove any offensive content and to get it back for sale is to protect our selves, our company and our IP.

[quote]
We are having a great time working on The ORION Project and are very excited for the upcoming Version 1.5.5 (Agora!) and Version 1.6 (PvP Module).

We believe we can create one of the best gaming experiences of all time and we need your help to do so. Spread the word, tell a friend, family member or post it somewhere you regularly visit. 

#ORION is on Steam for $1. 
Dinosaurs, Jetpacks & Mechs. 
Games Can't Fail - Only Developers Can.

We believe we can accomplish what we need marketing-wise with a little bit of your help. · 10,000,000 Starting Ion 
· Access to the first 20 Guardians

· Exclusive Elite Cloak 
· Exclusive Pet

( PROMOTIONS )
We currently have two promotions inside ORION. Login during June 2016 to redeem: 
· 5,000 Store Credit Reward (automated) 
· Fettuccine Helmet (redeem @ store) 


( LET'S DO THIS )
We believe we can create one of the best gaming experiences of all time and we need your help to do so. Spread the word, tell a friend, family member or post it somewhere you regularly visit. 

#ORION is on Steam for $1. 
Dinosaurs, Jetpacks & Mechs.

notes.title: ORION (Elite Edition) - Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RBzoPi3.png[/img]

The Steam Summer sale is upon us and we are celebrating in a big way!  We are proud to announce that ORION (Elite Edition) is now available!  This is a massive new way to support both ORION and the developer behind it, Trek Industries.

All of our products are on SALE!  This includes the new Elite Edition:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/493610
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900/


[h1]( WELCOME TO ORION )[/h1]
The ultimate Space Adventure and Combat Video Game for PC. The Orion Project is a living, breathing and Persistent Universe allowing for you to travel the Galaxy and experience Open World Gameplay like never before!
https://youtu.be/z-tvgi0ZzPo

Want to learn more??
https://youtu.be/VFopklaUqvg


[h1]( THE ELITE EDITION )[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/N5xrpOe.jpg[/img]

https://youtu.be/opJnNFi6mxs
[quote]
It is a brand new way to experience Orion and earn exclusive content and gear all while supporting Developers who will get to support you even more as a result. 

The Elite Package is $100 for new comers and only $50 for existing Founder Access members.  It includes:
· Loot Leveling System (Items as UNLOCKS instead of TRANSACTIONS) 
· 50% Store Savings* 
· 10,000,000 Starting Ion 
· Access to the first 20 Guardians 
· Exclusive Elite Armor 
· Exclusive Elite Helmet 
· Exclusive Elite Cloak 
· Exclusive Pet 
· Exclusive Game Icon

[img]http://i.imgur.com/17WFY2w.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QerZf2T.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/8Z6fvcA.png[/img]

[i]* Doesn't include content such as MECHS, STARSHIPS, CAMPAIGNS and RAIDS which will be Premium content for both Elite and Standard version owners. All of this *will* be eligible for the 50% discount. 

*UPGRADES from Founder to Elite can only be made via the in-game Trek Store.

*NEW OWNERS can purchase the Elite edition from the Trek Store or Steam Store.[/i]
[/quote]

[h1]( LOOT CRATES )[/h1]
A brand new addition to the game for Standard, Founder and Elite members.  
https://youtu.be/o1TvKFgFATM
These are available in the Trek Store (and as free unlocks for Elite members courtesy of the new Loot Leveling system) and can only be acquired through real-world currency towards Standard/Founder members.


[h1]( ORION LAUNCH MEDIA )[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9SquHm8.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/g8Y7vp2.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zAfxUWu.png[/img]


( CURRENT PROMOTIONS )
1,000 Free Credits (Thanks For Your Support!)
5,000 Free Credits (Login June 2016)
Free Fettuccine Helmet (Redeem @ Trek Store)


[h1]( WEEKLY CHALLENGE )[/h1]
There is a new weekly challenge every single week.  Each challenge has three different rewards for you to win, all of which grant Store Credits for you to spend!  Make sure to complete this Weeks Challenges in addition to your Daily Challenges!
https://youtu.be/8dhaI9ybxgk


[h1]( WE NEED YOUR HELP! )[/h1]
We believe we can create one of the best gaming experiences of all time and we need your help to do so. Spread the word, tell a friend, family member or post it somewhere you regularly visit. 

[i]#ORION is on Steam for $1. 
Dinosaurs, Jetpacks & Mechs. 
Games Can't Fail - Only Developers Can.[/i]

[h1]Tell a Friend, tell Family, tell EVERYONE!  The more you do for us the more we can do FOR YOU![/h1]


[h1]( SOME NOTES )[/h1]
We are aware of a few issues that will be resolved in Version 1.5.4.1, including:
· Issue with shaders/skins not saving.
· Walking Pet currently hovers.  New animations coming soon.
· Trench coat clipping base mesh on Player in-game.

Please let us know what you think.  If you have any issues please post them and we'll do our best to include any adjustments and tweaks with upcoming version/hotfix updates.


All of our products are on SALE!  This includes the new Elite Edition:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/493610
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/104900/


[h1]Games Can't Fail, 
Only Developers Can[/h1]
[b]So Support Developers Who Support Their Fans![/b]

notes.title: You Have No Idea How Powerful YOU Are!
notes.content:
We absolutely love our community.  That means YOU.  We posted something pretty low-key today, in two areas (Steam News/Steam DIscussions) that went something like this:

Well, the day is not even over yet and you guys seemingly have answered the call and really hit the ground running.  Our sales are rather (freakishly) consistent for quite some time now so gauging spikes/surges and finding their source is extremely easy - especially when there are no events or sales going on, like right now.

Orion has sold at a 400% increase today compared to any other day in recent history.  This is on track to hit anywhere from 600-800% by days end.  This is monumental and it only illustrates how powerful you all are and what you are capable of doing.

[h1]The more you give us, the more we can do for you.  [/h1]

[h1]1,000 FREE CREDITS![/h1]
As always, you're support will never go unappreciated and because of this we are crediting ALL users 1,000 Store Credits via Login once the new Version 1.5.4 becomes available tomorrow.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QerZf2T.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/8Z6fvcA.png[/img]


[h1]Q2 - WHAT DOES THE ELITE PACKAGE INCLUDE?[/h1]
The Elite Package includes a variety of starting content.  We also are scheduled to add additional exclusive items for Elite owners on a regular basis.  The base package will launch with
[quote]
[list]
[*]· Loot Leveling System (Items as UNLOCKS instead of TRANSACTIONS)
[*]· 50% Store Savings* 
[*]· 10,000,000 Starting Ion 
[*]· Access to the first 20 Guardians 
[*]· Exclusive Elite Armor 
[*]· Exclusive Elite Helmet 
[*]· Exclusive Elite Cloak 
[*]· Exclusive Pet 
[*]· Exclusive Game Icon
[/list]

* Doesn't include content such as MECHS, STARSHIPS, CAMPAIGNS and RAIDS which will be Premium content for both Elite and Standard version owners. All of this *will* be eligible for the 50% discount. 

*The Elite Package is expected to launch Summer 2016. 
[/quote]


[h1]Q3 - WHAT ARE LOOT LEVELS?[/h1]
This is a new progression system exclusively created for The Elite Package.  This rewards a variety of Loot Crates (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and allows you to UNLOCK Store Items rather than have to purchase them.  This is called EliteXP, otherwise also known as Loot Leveling.

https://youtu.be/o1TvKFgFATM
[quote]
You can make progress on your EliteXP in a variety of ways, with each earned Loot Level unlocking a new crate:
[list]
[*] EliteXP users will earn 10,000 Elite XP every hour of gameplay.  This will be limited to 10,000 EliteXP per single game.
[*] Various amounts of EliteXP are granted for Wins/Losses, all dependent on which Difficulty is being played.
[*] Future modules will also support EliteXP/LootLevels, including the upcoming PvP Modules.
[/list]
[/quote]

No - everything is the same, as it was before the Elite Package.


[h1]Q6 - ARE THERE ANY DIFFERENCES GOING INTO THE FUTURE FOR FOUNDERS/STANDARD OWNERS?[/h1]
Everything is the same except that Loot Crates are announced for the Store. These can be PAID or PLAYED for. 


[h1]Q7 - ARE THERE ANY RETROACTIVE REWARDS FOR LOOT CRATES?[/h1]
This was not possible as the Loot Crates are attached to a specialized progression system, rather than just using the already-existing Guardian Level/Progression systems.  This was done for many reasons including security and longevity.


[h1]Q8 - WILL THE OPEN GALAXY MODULE BE PREMIUM?[/h1]
No! Open Galaxy is a FREE addition to both Elite & Standard owners of the game. This includes a free Guardian Starship. The only premium content related to this module are additional Starships at the Store which can be PAID or PLAYED for and are cosmetic variants to customize your appearance. 


[h1]Q9 - WILL THE MECH MODULE BE PREMIUM?[/h1]
No! The Mech Module is a FREE addition to both Elite & Standard owners of the game. This includes a free Mech unit for EACH class (Light, Meidum, Heavy) as well as the Mech Weapons.. The only premium content related to this module are additional Mechs at the Store which can be PAID or PLAYED for and are cosmetic variants to customize your appearance. 


[h1]Q10 - DO YOU NEED A KEY TO UNLOCK CRATES?[/h1]
Absolutely not, gross.


[h1]Q11 - IS IT WORTH UPGRADING FROM FOUNDER TO ELITE?[/h1]
To be honest, probably not for most and it was designed this way. The only major differences between Elite and Founder are the exclusive cosmetic items, 10 games worth of Ion equalling $1 and the biggest addition which is the confirmation/inclusion of the first 20 Guardians. That last part may be the only part that would be worth it to YOU the player. However this is also an option for people that do love exclusive items or simply want to support us in that way. 


[h1]Q12 - WILL THE ELITE PROGRAM EVER GO AWAY?[/h1]
It is scheduled to be around permanently. 


[h1]Q13 - WHEN WILL THE ELITE PACKAGE GO ON SALE?[/h1]
That is scheduled to begin on June 23, 2016.


[h1]Q14 - WILL THE 20 GUARDIANS FOR ELITE BE AVAILABLE TO STANDARD/FOUNDERS?[/h1]
Absolutely - they will use the same Store. 


If you find that you have any additional questions once reading through this please post below and we will do our best to address all of them.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840

notes.title: Are You ELITE??
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RqDbbxv.png[/img]
The Elite Package is coming soon!  It features exclusive items and rewards and will allow you to further support the games production and the team behind it.


[h1]( THE ELITE PACKAGE )[/h1]
We are scheduled to offer a new version of The Orion Project which will be the Elite Package.  This will retail for $100 towards new owners and only a $50 upgrade option available for Founders if they wish to do so as it is NOT required. 
[quote]
[b]Elite Package Details[/b]
· Armors/Hats/Helmets/Skins as UNLOCKS instead of TRANSACTIONS
· 50% Store Savings*
· 10,000,000 Starting Ion
· Access to the first 20 Guardians
· Exclusive Elite Armor
· Exclusive Elite Helmet
· Exclusive Elite Cloak
· Exclusive Pet
· Exclusive Game Icon
[/quote]
[i]* Doesn't include content such as MECHS, STARSHIPS, CAMPAIGNS and RAIDS which will be Premium content for both Elite and Standard version owners.  All of this *will* be eligible for the 50% discount.

*The Elite Package is expected to launch Summer 2016.[/i]

[h1]( THE ELITE ARMOR )[/h1]
Inspired and paying homage to the likes of the Nano Suit & Kylo Ren.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/YMOSaPe.png[/img]

[h1]( THE ELITE TRENCH COAT ) [/h1]
Inspired and paying homage to the likes of Gambit & Star Lord.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/UfZfJ3Y.jpg[/img]

[h1]( THE ELITE PET )[/h1]
Your own personal 'lil buddy - T.O.D - or the Tactical Oblierator Drone.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/oIMLHtvh.jpg[/img]

[h1]( SAVE BIG )[/h1]
Starting at the end of this month, you will be able to, as both Standard and Founder, save big money on upgrading to Elite. This will be a one-time, massive saving's event allowing both types of Players to save 50% on the sticker price!  So instead of $100 and $50 it will be $50 and $25.  Make sure to tell your friends, as it will never be priced lower!


[h1]( LOOT CRATES & LOOT LEVELS )[/h1]
Loot Crates are coming to both versions of the game, Standard & Elite.  For the Standard version of the game all three versions of the Loot Crate will be available at the Trek Store for the following prices:
· Bronze Crate: $1
· Silver Crate: $5
· Gold Crate: $10

For the Elite Package, these Crates are unlocked at Leveling intervals courtesy of a new LOOT LEVELING system specific to the Elite Version.  Bronze unlocks *every* level while Silver is unlocked on the 5th and Gold on the 10th interval.  

These Loot Crates can contain a variety of item types, including but not limited to: Weapon Skins, Armor Skins, Hats, Helmets, Armors, Particle Skins, Ion, Credits and many more types of content that we will add over time.  Each category of crate holds a different amount of items inside.

- - - 
[h1] ( FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS )[/h1]
I've also gathered as many community questions regarding The Elite Package as I could and have posted the answers below:
[quote]
[B]Q1 - Will the Open Galaxy Module be Premium?[/B]
No! Open Galaxy is a FREE addition to both Elite & Standard owners of the game. This includes a free Guardian Starship. The only premium content related to this module are additional Starships at the Store which can be PAID or PLAYED for and are cosmetic variants to customize your appearance.

[B]Q2 - Will the Mech Module be Premium?[/B]
No! The Mech Module is a FREE addition to both Elite & Standard owners of the game. This includes a free Mech unit for EACH class (Light, Meidum, Heavy) as well as the Mech Weapons.. The only premium content related to this module are additional Mechs at the Store which can be PAID or PLAYED for and are cosmetic variants to customize your appearance.

[B]Q3 - Does this in any way affect the present for Founders/Standard owners?[/B]
No - everything is the same, as it was before the announcement.

[B]Q4 - Are there any differences going into the future for Founders/Standar owners?[/B]
Everything is the same except that Loot Crates are announced for the Store.  These can be PAID or PLAYED for.

[B]Q5 - Do you need a Key to unlock said Loot Crates?[/B]
Gross, absolutely not.

[B]Q7 - If I have Founder Access, is it worth it to upgrade to Elite?[/B]
To be honest, probably not for most and it was designed this way.  The only major differences between Elite and Founder are the exclusive cosmetic items, 10 games worth of Ion equalling $1 and the biggest addition which is the confirmation/inclusion of the first 20 Guardians.  That last part may be the only part that would be worth it to YOU the player.  However this is also an option for people that do love exclusive items or simply want to support us in that way.

[B]Q8 - Will the Elite program ever go away?[/B]
It is scheduled to be around permanently.

[B]Q9 - When will the Elite program begin?[/B]
No official date just yet, working on getting Version 1.5 out to the public and we will have more details.

[B]Q10 - Founders can upgrade for $50 instead of $100?[/B]
Yes that is correct.

[B]Q11 - Is there a limit to how long Founders can do the $50 upgrade?[/B]
It is scheduled to be permanent.

[B]Q12 - If I upgrade to Elite and get unlocks instead of purchases, what happens to my already-achieved Levels per Guardian?[/B]
Originally there was no retro-active reward.  But we will find a way to honor already-completed levels using the announced model (Bronze/Silver/Gold crate distribution).

[B]Q13 - Will the 20 Guardians towards Elite be available to other owners (Standard/Founders)?[/B]
Absolutely - they will use the same Store.

[B]Q14 - If I am a Founder with 50% Savings already and upgrade to Elite with that 50% stack for 100% Savings?[/B]
Of course not.

[B]Q15 - Is the Elite Pet faster or better in any way?[/B]
No it just looks different, cosmetic only.  No Pay-2-Win!
[/quote]

The Orion Project
$1 or $100
Play Your Way
http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

notes.title: Version 1.6 - Changing Things Up (Guardians)
notes.content:
Version 1.6 - Changing Things Up
We recently re-designed how Guardian Purchases will work going forward, likely starting with Version 1.6. I want to split up the cost of the Guardians as they currently stand, and to do this the best way is to split the gameplay from the visual:

1. We are going to sell new Guardians (aka Playstyles) for $5. This includes the Ability, Weapon Loadout, Voice and more. 

2. Then we are going to sell the Armor pieces separately for the other $5, which would include the Helmet, Arms, Legs and Chest.

So it's still all the same content and this will allow us to add tons of armor to the store for users to enjoy at a much faster rate without having to hold it back to wait for Guardian/programming integration. It also allows more affordable prices across each and allows users to get exactly what they want.

notes.title: Elite Package, Loot Crates, Loot Levels, V1.5 Release
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/WEQj5c9.png[/img]
We are rapidly approaching the release of Version 1.5 and are just putting as many final touches in place before we let you all in and enjoy.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uRTnpp5ufD4

[h1]( VERSION 1.5 - FPS MODULE 1.0 )[/h1]
First public release of v1.5.0 is expected to debut TOMORROW, Saturday - June 4, 2016.  We will follow up with a v1.5.1 to add/adjust a few things that are known but also integrating any community-posted feedback.

This is the biggest update yet adding the much demanded FPS portion of the game.  While already even more in-depth and amazing than what we did with Prelude we've already announced/confirmed/committed to more!  We will be doing an FPS Module 2.0 follow up in 2017 and further the content by adding Weapon Sights (ADS) and Weapon Attachments/Customization.
 

[h1]( ELITE PACKAGE )[/h1]
We are scheduled to offer a new version of The Orion Project which will be the Elite Package.  This will retail for $100 towards new owners and only a $50 upgrade option available for Founders if they wish to do so as it is NOT required. 
[quote]
[b]Elite Package Details[/b]
· Armors/Hats/Helmets/Skins as UNLOCKS instead of TRANSACTIONS
· 50% Store Savings*
· 10,000,000 Starting Ion
· Access to the first 20 Guardians
· Exclusive Elite Armor
· Exclusive Elite Helmet
· Exclusive Elite Cloak
· Exclusive Pet
· Exclusive Game Icon
[/quote]
[i]* Doesn't include content such as MECHS, STARSHIPS, CAMPAIGNS and RAIDS which will be Premium content for both Elite and Standard version owners.  All of this *will* be eligible for the 50% discount.

*The Elite Package is expected to launch Summer 2016.[/i]


[h1]( LOOT CRATES & LOOT LEVELS )[/h1]
Loot Crates are coming to both versions of the game, Standard & Elite.  For the Standard version of the game all three versions of the Loot Crate will be available at the Trek Store for the following prices:
· Bronze Crate: $1
· Silver Crate: $5
· Gold Crate: $10

For the Elite Package, these Crates are unlocked at Leveling intervals courtesy of a new LOOT LEVELING system specific to the Elite Version.  Bronze unlocks *every* level while Silver is unlocked on the 5th and Gold on the 10th interval.  

These Loot Crates can contain a variety of item types, including but not limited to: Weapon Skins, Armor Skins, Hats, Helmets, Armors, Particle Skins, Ion, Credits and many more types of content that we will add over time.  Each category of crate holds a different amount of items inside.

The Orion Project
$1 or $100
Play Your Way

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840/

notes.title: Version 1.6 - First Details!
notes.content:
We are gearing up to release Version 1.5 in the next couple of days/week and are very excited to share what we've been working on with you.

We have had the Pre-Production and Production teams working on Version 1.6 and 1.7 while the Integration team finished off 1.5.  We have just settled on the main focus areas for 1.6 and they are listed below:

[h1] MECHS! [/h1]
We are going to launch with three classes and a unit per each.  This is in addition to a unique set of weaponry created just for the mechs.

[h1] PvP! [/h1]
We are going to launch Version 1.6 with three PvP game modes!

[b]( MAYHEM ) (40 Players) (Free-For-All)[/b]
[list]
[*] This is one of the largest PvP mode offerings for the immediate future.  
[*] This will use specialized NEW maps like The Cove + The Island.
[*] This allows for ALL Guardians to be used and will be a great way to see ability VS ability.
[/list]

[b]( HARVESTER HUNT ) (4v4, Team Elimination)[/b]
[list]
[*] This pits two teams against one another, each tasked with having to protect their Harvester unit from the enemy team AND wild life, all while trying to eliminate the opposing teams unit.
[*] This will use existing maps such as Relic, Haven, Strike and more.
[/list]

[b]( MECH WARS ) (4v4, Team Objective)[/b]
[list]
[*] This will feature all the new mechs and mech content and pay homage to other games like Mech Assault and Titan Fall.
[*] This will use existing maps such as Relic, Haven, Strike and more.
[/list]

notes.title: Nova City - Reveal Teaser
notes.content:
[h1]VERSION 1.7 WILL BE EPIC![/h1]
We have just started Pre-Production on Version 1.6 and Version 1.7. We are especially excited for 1.7 because it will be the first time we are able to introduce new creatures and species from within the Orion universe.
https://youtu.be/ezaMaVpWZWI

We are adding many Social/RPG modules including the Exploration Module. This is scheduled to allow you to explore three massive locations at launch, including Nova City, The Cove and Enclave. There are unique characters in each location and you'll be able to interact with them to Buy, Shop and Trade!

[quote]
[h1]MORTY FLINT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Height: 8 Feet, 6 Inches
[*] Weight: 1,250 Pounds
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/dsBiJsv.jpg[/img]
Here is the first sketch of Morty Flint, a Rekan species from the Rock World of Okra. Many of the Rekan species were bred as warriors due to their nearly indestructible skin.

Now retired from war, Morty can be found in the Mining Colony of Nova City where he sells Weapons & Gear for a price.
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]RUNO OSO[/h1]
[list]
[*] Height: 4 Feet, 2 Inches

notes.title: Galactic Council Module (2017) - Register Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/0yhbAbQ.png[/img]

[i]We are announcing the [b]Galactic Council Module[/b] quite a early (won't be coming for a year or so) but it's in order to begin receiving as much information and as many applicants as possible.  If you want to become even more involved with development and or the community, this news is for YOU![/i]

The [b]Galactic Council (/Order of Ion) Module[/b] is a future module coming to The Orion Project that begins to involve the community in new and incredible ways.  We're very big on developing this game right aside you and want to illustrate this starting here.

This will be an annual event and the first election will be in 2017.  It will be an voting-based election and allow for 10 community members to become elected and have a seat at the Galactic Council.  This will coincide with the other 10 seats primarily made up of Developers known as the "Order of Ion" and will be the acting arm for the word of the Galactic Council.

[quote]
[h1]( HOW TO REGISTER ) [/h1]
To become eligible for a Galactic Council seat you must prepare a presentation (written or recorded) and submit it to council@trek-industries.com by January 1, 2017.  In this presentation you must cover seven topics:

1. Why are you interested?
2. What would make you/your perspective unique?
3. What is(are) your current favorite game(s)?
4. What is(are) your favorite game(s) of all time?
5. What is your Age?
6. What is your Gender?
7. Do you have any past experience in serving/representation in real life or another game community (admin, moderator, etc).
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1]( GALACTIC COUNCIL PERKS )[/h1]
As a Galactic Council member you will receive a plethora of exclusive perks, including:
[list]
[*] Annual Seat @ Galactic Council
[*] Access to Council Cloak
[*] Access to Council Ion Blade
[*] Access to Council Armor Set
[*] Access to Council Pet
[*] Access to Council game icon
[*] Access to ION Council Multi-Person Starship
[*] Access to monthly ION Meetings
[*] Access to WIP Developer Builds
[*] Access to exclusive Galactic areas including Shrines and Temples
[*] Galactic protection by the Ion Drone Army
[/list]
[/quote]

[quote]
[h1] ( GALACTIC COUNCIL RESPONSIBILITIES )[/h1]
Council Members will be involved in major decisions, including but not limited 
[list]
[*] Toxic Player Behavior & Remediation
[*] Banning/Jailing/Fining
[*] Aiding in Player Disputes
[*] Access to Exclusive Missions from James Trek
[*] Lore/Archive Buildup (finding Data Logs as a Council Member makes them available for other players to read/discover in Library/Archive areas of future modules).
[*] + more!
[/quote]

This is just a very early announcement.  If anyone is interested in this module please apply and look forward to meeting you soon!

notes.title: Your Feedback - The Results!
notes.content:
We started a poll yesterday trying to obtain as much feedback as possible about your experiences with The Orion Project.  We asked you to answer three questions:
[code]
1 - What do you currently love the most? 
2 - What do you currently dislike the most? 
3 - What feature/module/component are you looking forward to the most? 
[/code]

[h1]( WHAT YOU LOVE )[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gameplay
[*] Camera Switching
[*] Skills/Gear Systems
[*] Music
[*] Augments
[*] Class Variety
[*] Dinosaurs
[*] Loot
[*] Visuals
[*] RPG Elements
[/list]

[h1]( WHAT YOU DISLIKE )[/h1]
[list]
[*] Current User Interface
[*] Current 3rd Person Animations
[*] Performance/Optimization
[*] HUD Vanishing Bug
[*] Harv in Survival (devnotes: swapping to a stationary Power Core)
[*] Current Party/Friend Invite/Join system
[*] Loading Screens
[*] Server Performance (f2p week)
[/list]

[h1]( WHAT YOU WANT THE MOST )[/h1]
[list]
[*] First Person Module***
[*] Open Galaxy Module
[*] Open World Module
[*] The Island Module (40-Player, FFA PvP)
[*] Guardian Creation Module
[*] New 3rd Person Action Camera
[*] Raids/Strike Module (10 Player Co-Op Missions)
[*] The Citadel Module (Player Housing)
[*] The Dungeon Module (Hardcore PvE, Robots, Rare Items)
[*] New Maps, Enemies & Bosses 
[*] Vehicles + Mech Module
[*] Social Modules (Nova City, NPC's, Vendors, Trading, Markets)
[*] Ability to purchase the OST
[*] More Modes
[*] Weapon Loadout Variety for each Guardian
[*] New Guardians
[*] Quests
[*] Updated AI, mostly for Vertical/On-Rock Players
[*] Improved Crafting System+Tutorial
[*] More Side Objectives (Harvest)
[*] Clan System
[*] More Voice Commands/Additional Personality
VoIP/Voice Chat
[*] Pets/Loot Collectors

notes.content:

[/code]

Fixed issue with Bonus Loot Chest not spawning

notes.title: Welcome To The Orion Project!
notes.content:
We have some BIG news to share!  We have recently completely expanded our intentions for this title and renamed it to The Orion Project to reflect this.  

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840


[h1] ( THE UNIVERSE EXPANDED ) [/h1]
We have a 5+ year development schedule in place for The Orion Project and will be regularly updating the game with brand new features and content while retaining what everyone already loves.  We will be beginning with new modules such as: First-Person, PvP, Cities with Vendors and NPCs, Mechs and Open Galaxy Gameplay.



[h1] ( ABOUT THE ORION PROJECT ) [/h1]
The Orion Project will be only $1 and will become the ultimate video game for PC with gameplay consisting of four main modules, including: Social, Exploration, Adventure and Combat. 

https://youtu.be/-0W3cwwMqwE

The Orion Project is a living, breathing and Persistent Universe allowing for you to travel the Galaxy and experience Open World Gameplay like never before! Explore vast Regions each with unique Wildlife and Weather patterns, to Harvest and collect resources, Loot Gear and Level up your Characters while fighting through a variety of Objectives, Missions and Quests. 

https://youtu.be/TtmRUGtyXX0
Take to the skies and visit neighboring Planets and Moons using your Guardian Starship. Arrive at Orbital Command or Nova City, a Social Hub for a large number of players to Interact, Trade, Meet or Shop at or take a moment to relax at your new Residence located at The Citadel. 

[h1]Welcome to the Galaxy - Endless possibilities await[/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407840
